business_summary: Virtualex Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in IT and consulting, and outsourcing business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in contact center operation; acts as generalists; onsite team engineering, offshore development, and IT operation outsourcing businesses; research and development, and acquisition of new technology and solution. It also provides consultation, outsourcing, and CRM software development services; web system, educational solution, and research and development related to AI; operational base for contact center outsourcing and BPO service; and digital marketing services. The company was formerly known as Virtualex Consulting, Inc. and changed its name to Virtualex Holdings, Inc. in October 2017. Virtualex Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Atrae, Inc. plans, develops, and manages job information websites in Japan. The company offers Green, a contingency-based recruitment media that matches jobseekers who wish to change jobs with hiring companies on the internet; Wevox, an organizational capabilities platform that promotes the utilization and retention of human resources by visualizing engagement; and Yenta, a matching application that uses artificial intelligence to create encounters between businesspeople. It also establishes a professional basketball club, Altiri Chiba, in Chiba City. Atrae, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

CAREER CO., LTD. engages in the provision of human resources services for aging society in Japan. It engages in general worker dispatch, outsourcing, recruitment consulting, and job advertisement, business contract; and paid employment placement businesses. The company also offers staffing services for nurses and caregivers who support these services, labor dispatch personnel introductions, and home care services; employment support services for people with disabilities; HR tech services; and temporary staffing services. CAREER CO., LTD. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

SERAKU Co., Ltd. operates as internet system integrator in Japan. It offers digital transformation services, including cloud technologies and cybersecurity for protecting the information assets of companies, IoT service, AI and data science, robotic process automation, and Midori cloud; maintenance and operation service of 24-hour/365-day on SERAKUs IoT cloud support center; and customer success solutions business for the use of Salesforce. The company also provides Midori cloud and farm cloud services to support in agriculture and fisheries sectors; and system integration services, such as IT infrastructure and cloud technologies, digital creative, web operations, web system development, and other services. In addition, it provides mechanical design engineering services, such as engineer dispatch, commissioned contracting, and engineer training services for design and development centered on CAD and drafting technology. SERAKU Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Insource Co., Ltd. provides various lecturer dispatch type training, open lecture, and other services in Japan. It offers on-site training; open seminars; educational; IT services; and engages other businesses, such as e-learning/video production, online seminar administration services, video training content, workshop and consulting services, DX promotion support, AI/ RPA introduction support, online seminar agency, and recruitment services. Insource Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Howa Machinery, Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment, firearms, special-purpose vehicles, building materials, electronic machines, sweepers, metal joinery fittings, and firearms in Japan. It operates through seven segments: Machine Tool Related, Firearms, Specially Equipped Vehicle, Building Materials, Real Estate Leasing, Domestic Sales Subsidiary, and Domestic Transportation Subsidiary. The company's machine tools include machining centers, transfer lines, and standard machine tool units for transfer lines; and pneumatic and hydraulic equipment comprises power chucks, rotating cylinders, rodless slit and magnetic type cylinders, hydraulic and pneumatic clamp cylinders, hydraulic jig cylinders, rotary actuators, and hydraulic cylinders. It also provides electronic machines, which include exposure systems for printed circuit boards, ceramic green sheet-related equipment, and testing systems for mounted circuit boards; sweepers used for cleaning in streets, factories, and public and leisure facilities; and sporting rifles. The company was formerly known as Howa Heavy Industries, Ltd. and changed its name to Howa Machinery, Ltd. in 1945. Howa Machinery, Ltd. was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Kiyosu, Japan.

Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. engages in paper converting machinery business in Japan. It offers corrugated cardboard box making and printing machines, cardboard weight packaging machines, and yarn twisting machines, as well as defense equipment. The company was formerly known as Ishii Iron Works and changed its name to Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. in July 1938. Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Hakusan, Japan.

NPR-Riken Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automobile engine parts, marine engine parts, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts Business, Piping and Construction Equipment Business, Thermal Engineering Business, and Other segments. It offers piston rings for automobiles, construction machinery, marine engines, and power generation; evaluation and simulation analysis services, piston ring museum; marine and industrial components and parts, seal rings for industrial equipment; resin seal rings, resin gears; precision machined components, such as turbo changer seal rings, valve lifters, aluminum vanes, cylinder liners; sintered components, including valve seat inserts, powder metal assembled camshafts, material to strengthen bearing; cast iron components comprising suspension and steering, cast iron camshafts; piping products; thermal engineering, consists heating element PYROMAX, industrial furnaces, heater units; EMC, electromagnetic anechoic chambers; metal injection molding components; surface treatment technologies, DLC and TiN coating; electric unit products; engineered plastic products; electromagnetic noise countermeasure products; NiFreeT, a titanium-tantalum alloy products; medical and disaster emergency products, such as disaster emergency medical, dental implant, radiology medical devices, and other products; and recreation vehicles products. NPR-Riken Corporation was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. NPR-Riken Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Npr-Riken Corporation.

Tsudakoma Corp. produces and sells textile machinery and machine tool attachments in Japan, Asia, North and south America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Textile Machinery Business and Machine Tool Related Business. The company offers textile machinery comprising air jet looms, water jet looms, and preparatory machines. It also provides composite machinery, such as prepreg slitters, automated fiber lay-up machines, auto lay-up machines, multi-axial UD auto lay-up systems, auto edge welding machines, profile molding machines, carbon fiber rapier looms, and drape forming systems. In addition, the company offers machines, including NC rotatory tables, machine vises, and manual tables. Further, it provides castings for textile machinery and preparation machinery, machine tool attachments, and various industrial machinery. The company was formerly known as TSUDAKOMA Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tsudakoma Corp. in 1982. Tsudakoma Corp. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Kanazawa, Japan.

ENSHU Limited manufactures and sells machine tools and parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers system equipment, such as flexible transfer lines, flexible manufacturing systems, and other production lines controlled by computers; and general-purpose machines, which include machining centers and NC machines, as well as high power laser diode and diode plastic welding systems. It also manufactures parts for motorcycle engines, snowmobiles, golf carts, buggies, and other vehicles; and machines and assembles diesel engines. The company was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.

Shima Seiki Mfg.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, sells, markets, and services knitting machines, design systems, and automatic fabric cutting machines in Japan, Europe, the Middle East, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers computerized flat, and glove and sock knitting machines under the WHOLEGARMENT brand; and peripherals. It also provides SDS-ONE APEX series, which consists of an all-in-one system, a design system with integrated hardware and software; and APEXFiz, a design software subscription service. In addition, the company offers P-CAM, a series of automatic fabric cutting machines; P-LAB automatic labeling machines; P-SPR 2 spreading machines; PMK 1600/2000 inkjet marking plotters; CAD/CAM systems; and SHIMA KnitManager, a production management software. Further, it is involved in the provision of service and maintenance services; manufacture of machine parts; production of cashmere yarns; sale of REPAC and ReMateri yarns; operation of BLUEKNIT, an online shopping mall for knits; Auberge de South Terrace, a hotel located in Nanki Shirahama; food services business; and operates Fusion museum. The company serves fashion, sports/outdoor, healthcare, shoes and accessories, home furnishings, automotive, aeronautical, and industrial materials industries. Shima Seiki Mfg.,Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Wakayama, Japan.

Seibu Giken Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmental conservation and energy-saving equipment in Japan, China, rest of Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers DRY-SAVE desiccant dehumidifiers, VOC concentrators, total heat and sensible heat exchangers, outdoor air handling unit, dry air globoxes, circulating nitrogen purifiers, dry room dehumidifier, dry and nitrogen gas booths, solvent recovery systems, and direct air capture CO2 concentrations device for greenhouse and vertical. The company provides honeycomb and after-sales services. Its products are used in various applications, such as for lithium-ion battery, semiconductor, OLED, perovskite solar cell, perovskite solar cell, building air conditioning, power plant, chemical product, painting and printing, and food and pharmaceuticals. The company was formerly known as Seibu Giken Technology Research Co., Ltd. and changed its name Seibu Giken Co.Ltd in July 1995. Seibu Giken Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Koga, Japan.

JRC Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells conveyor parts in Japan. It operates through Conveyor Business, Environmental Plant Business, and Robot SI Business segments. The company offers laura, pulley, and stand; belt cleaner, conveyor cover, safety products and other conveyor peripherals; apron, belt, screw, and flight conveyor; storage hopper, double damper, rotary dust and quantitative feeder, tank, duct, and mounting stand; and idlers, rollers, and lightweight idlers and rollers. It also provides services in conveyor equipment operation; conveyor equipment maintenance service; conveyor construction; installation work, renovation and improvement work, renewal work, regular inspection of equipment, equipment maintenance, and research and installation of other companies' products. In addition, the company offers robot palletizing system, robot depalletizing system, robot caser, mobile collaborative robot unit, and transport robot system base 3-piece set; and high-speed picking system and automatic machine OEM. JRC Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

long_name: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
business_summary: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, maintenance, upgrade and repair, renewal, and installation of elevators, vertical automatic conveyors, and other transport machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers elevators, freight elevators, ship elevators, and maclifter. Its products are used in government agencies, public corporations, freezers and refrigerated warehouses, seafood, manufacturing, trading companies, commercial businesses, real estate sector, Construction company, ship, and warehouse and transportation industries. Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

AIMECHATEC, Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells for flat panel display equipment in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Related Business; LCD Business; and IJP Solution Business segments. The company offers plasma asher, etcher, UV equipment for power semiconductor production, wafer handling systems, and solder ball mounters. It also provides seal application, liquid crystal dropping, and vacuum lamination equipment used in the production process of liquid crystal display panels for televisions, smartphones. In addition, it provides after-sales services. Further, it offers life cycle support services, such as process support, proposal for latest equipment and mechanism, renewal and maintenance, research and development, and training; and spare parts. AIMECHATEC, Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is based in Ryugasaki, Japan.

J.E.T. Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, manufacture, sale, and service of semiconductor cleaning equipment in Japan, South Korea, China, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers batch type and single wafer cleaning equipment, as well as inspection and manufacturing equipment for lithium-ion batteries, such as electrolyte leak inspection devices and ultrasonic bonding systems. It also provides organic agricultural products. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Asakuchi, Japan. J.E.T. Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Zeus Co.,Ltd.

Okumura Engineering corp. engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of various valves for industrial, building, and marine applications. It manufactures and sells butterfly pipes used in construction, power generation, shipbuilding, and various plants industries. The company also provides fluid control equipment; pinch and knife gate valves; land-based applications such as building equipment, petrochemicals, steel and metals, electricity and gas, machinery and equipment, and paper and pulp industries; and marine based products to various shipyards. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Yasu, Japan.

Sanei Ltd. manufactures and sells plumbing fixtures in Japan. The company provides mixing plugs, sensors and touch faucets, set items, washbasin and hand washbasin, single faucet, shower, interior accessories, branch, faucet parts, valve, piping system, piping components, kitchen accessories, bath and air conditioning accessories, washbasin accessories, washing machine accessories, toilet accessories, gardening accessories, and tools. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

KIMURA KOHKI Co.,Ltd. engaged in the design, manufacture, and sale of air-conditioning and heat exchanger equipment in Japan. It offers system products, cold/hot water type products, air-cooled direct expansion and heat pump type products, factory/air conditioning equipment, water-cooled heat pump type products, induction type air outlet products, and heat exchangers, and related air conditioners equipment. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

ACSL Ltd. manufactures industrial drones in Japan and internationally. It offers delivery, inspection, disaster relief, and emerging use-case solutions; and solution services for automation with autonomous technology. The company was formerly known as Autonomous Control Systems Laboratory Ltd. and changed its name to ACSL Ltd. in June 2021. ACSL Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Edogawa, Japan.

KLASS Corporation manufactures and sells professional machines and tools in Japan. It operates through four segments: Professional, Consumer, Industry, and New Industry. The Professional segment offers interior construction equipment, such as automatic wallpaper gluing machines; sign/display related equipment that comprises film laminating machines; tapes for interior work and related tools; computer software; Tatami manufacturing equipment, which includes a computerized Tatami manufacturing system, as well as related tools/auxiliary materials; and Goolip, a quotation and billing management tool. The Consumer segment engages in the sale of interior products, such as special function tatami mats; provision of replacement of tatami mats and sliding doors for general households; and sale and installation of industrial and residential solar power generation systems, and storage batteries, as well as offers house renovation work. The Industry segment designs, develops, and manufactures industrial equipment, such as secondary battery manufacturing equipment; and sells food equipment for kitchens comprising multi-dispensers. The New Industry segment offers water jet technology, and develops and sells automation systems. The company was formerly known as Kyokuto Sanki Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to KLASS Corporation in October 2023. KLASS Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tatsuno, Japan.

Optorun Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells optical thin film equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers ion source beam assisted deposition system, including optical thin film coaters, super multilayer optical coaters, and optical thin film coater for mass production; reactive plasma deposition system; metal mode sputtering system, such as optical thin film and optical wafer level sputtering coaters; and plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition system. It also provides iron sources; and optical monitors. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacturing, distribution, import, and export of vacuum coating machines, peripheral equipment, and units using vacuum coating products; and provision of maintenance and consulting services. Its products are used in clean energy, display, optical communications, semiconductor, optical storage media, bio-industry, consumer products, and vehicle-mounted device applications. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tsurugashima, Japan.

Iwaki Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacturing, procurement, and sales of chemical pumps and peripheral equipment in Japan, Europe, the United States, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers magnetic drive pumps, motor driven metering pumps, electromagnetic metering pumps, pneumatic drive pumps, rotary displacement pumps, air pumps, and reciprocating diaphragm liquid pumps; and non-metal magnetic drive turbine pumps MDT series and metallic centrifugal magnetic drive pumps MP series. It also provides system products comprising water treatment controllers, such as Walchem controller Intuition-9, Walchem controller Intuition-6, and Walchem controller P100 and W100. Iwaki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Nagaoka International Corporation manufactures and sells water intake and treatment systems, and screen internals to the oil refining and petrochemical industries in Japan and internationally. It also provides water intake screens for groundwater and other purposes, such as waterworks, industrial facilities, farming, and fish farms; and the technology of water treatment for drinkable and commercial use. The company was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Nagaoka International Corporation is a subsidiary of HAMADA Co., Ltd.

Yamashin-Filter Corp. operates as a filter manufacturer in Japan, Asia, the United States of America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Filter Business and Air Filter Business. The company manufactures, develops, and sells filters for construction and agricultural machines, drive-trains, fuel systems and various filter products for industrial and precision machines, and industrial filter related parts; and nano filter products. Its construction machinery filters, including hydraulic fluid filters to protect hydraulic equipment, such as cylinders; engine oil filters that are used in various types of engines to filter fine dust in engine oil; fuel filters used to construction machinery to remove dust and moisture contained in fuel for diesel engines; transmission filters for transmission mechanisms such as bulldozers and wheel loaders; industrial filters to filter hydraulic and lubricating oils, and other liquids in a range of industrial machinery; and process filters, which are used for filtration and separation in manufacturing processes across a range of industries, including electronic parts, precision components, LCD displays, and food products. The company also provides various types of air filters for a range of settings, such as office buildings, factories, equipment, and vehicles; and medical-grade masks and replacement inner sheets that are made using YAMASHIN NANO FILTER. The company was formerly known as Yamashin Industry Inc. and changed its name to Yamashin-Filter Corp. in October 2005. Yamashin-Filter Corp. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

HIRANO TECSEED Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of coating and laminating equipment, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. It operates through Coating machine related equipment, Chemical machinery related equipment, and Other segments. The company offers optical function film, flexible board, dry film, electronic materials, battery electrode, adhesive, release film and paper, carbon fiber prepreg, synthetic leather, hot-melt, and other coating lines. It also provides non-woven dryers, ceramic sheet forming lines, film stretching lines, glass cloth production lines, and multicoaters. HIRANO TECSEED Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Nara, Japan.

Techno Smart Corp. engaged in the machinery and equipment manufacturing industry. It offers liquid crystal-related film and cast film manufacturing devices; magnetic material coating devices; battery-related manufacturing devices; ceramic sheet manufacturing devices; carbon fiber and ceramic thermal processing devices; high-speed dryers and deodorizing devices for printing; and direct fired, catalytic, and heat storage-type deodorizers. The company was formerly known as Inoue Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Techno Smart Corp. in October 2012. Techno Smart Corp. was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Hisaka Works, Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. It operates through Heat Exchanger, Process Engineering, and Valve segments. The Heat Exchanger segment offers multi gap plates, semi-welded plates, fin tubes, double-lined gasket plates, plate condensers, corrugated plate patterns, dual wall plates, brazed plate heat exchangers, and sea water solutions. This segment's products are used in various applications, such as general manufacturing, chemicals, pulp and paper, pure water, cooking oil, steelmaking, petroleum refining, ships, soda, electricity, beer, and sulfuric acid. The Process Engineering segment provides food machinery, such as sterilizers, evaporator-concentrator systems, factory automation systems, and testing machine and other equipment; pharmaceutical purposes sterilizers, pharmaceutical liquid continuous sterilizers, evaporation concentrator systems, pure steam generators, plant engineering, and development test laboratory; and dyeing and finishing machinery consisting of liquid dyeing, multi-purpose air jet processing, dyeing processing, beam-dyeing, and cheese dyeing/drying machines, as well as options for dyeing equipment. The Valve segment offers various valves, such as 2-way ball, 3-way ball, 4-way ball, and diaphragm valves. The Other segment engages in the solar power generation business. The company was formerly known as MITSUISHI Ind. and changed its name to Hisaka Works, Ltd. in August 1951. Hisaka Works, Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd., provide fluid control solutions primarily for Water in Japan and internationally. The company develops, manufactures, and sells pumps, valves, devices, special alloys, and parts. The company offers self-priming centrifugal, enhanced self-priming, de-foaming/degassing, multistage and enhanced self-priming, turbine, process, centrifugal, multistage centrifugal, double suction volute, and mixed-flow volute pumps. It also provides non-water hammer check valves; wafer-type check valves; constant flow regulator valves; float-type regulator valves; and pilot-type regulator valves, including constant pressure, constant flow rate, liquid level-1 regulator, liquid level-2 regulator, safety, pressure relief, pressure sustaining, differential pressure regulator, and emergency shutoff valves. In addition, the company offers liquid-air switch valves and automatic-cleaning strainers; and special and seawater resistant stainless steel, casting parts, and non-external-flushing mechanical seal products. Further, the company provides installation and piping services. The company's products are used in ultra-pure water production, agricultural irrigation, civil engineering, construction, electric power generation, city water, sewage, chemical processing, plant equipment, food, medicine, aquariums, fisheries, and hot springs applications. It serves government and municipal offices, and other companies. The company was formerly known as Yokota Pump Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in 1959. Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

Gamecard Holdings, Inc. engages in gaming business. The company is involved in the issuance and sale PF pachinko prepaid cards; development and sale of IC card systems and peripheral devices for pachinko and slot machines; and sales promotion support for pachinko parlors. It sells prepaid cards, plan, develop, sell, lease, and maintain prepaid system equipment. The company was formerly known as Gamecard-Joyco Holdings,Inc. and changed its name to Gamecard Holdings, Inc. in October 2025. Gamecard Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1988 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Yamabiko Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural machinery in Japan, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Outdoor Power Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, and General Industrial Machinery segments. The company manufactures, sells, and rents handheld forestry and landscape maintenance machinery, such as chain saws for limbing, felling, and pruning trees; trimmers and brush cutters for grass cutting, mowing, and clearing; and power blowers for blowing, collecting, and shredding leaves and debris; provides boom sprayers for large-scale farm and crop operations; speed sprayers for fruit trees; mounted equipment for cropland pest control management, such as labor-saving pest control equipment for paddy fields, and soy and potato harvesters; generators, welding machines, lighting equipment, and high-pressure washers. Further, it manufactures and sells agricultural drainage pipe burying machinery; contract logistics; and manufactures and sells prototype parts for automobiles. It serves forests and agricultural fields, construction sites, parks, and homes under the Kioritz, Shindaiwa, and ECHO brand names. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ome, Japan.

Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. engages in the design, construction, and sale of water production equipment in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers water treatment plants and equipment, including pure and ultra-pure water systems, pharmaceutical water production systems, wastewater treatment systems, and water reclamation systems. It also provides pretreatment systems, heat regenerative type membrane filtration equipment, coagulating sedimentation equipment, flocculation filtration, gravity filtration, and pressure filtration equipment, electrodeionization, ion exchange systems, reverse osmosis (RO) systems, vacuum and membrane degasifier, pure steam generators, package type purified water production systems, WFI production systems, ozone and hydrogen water production systems, and anti-static equipment. In addition, the company offers return contamination monitor, endotoxin monitor, H2O2 monitor, nuclepore membrane, filter cartridge, and piping and environmental materials; and site supply of pure water, and water analysis and evaluation services on a contract basis. It serves electronics, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food, environmental energy, and analysis industries. Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Atsugi, Japan.

NPC Incorporated engages in the machinery and environmental businesses. The company researches and develops, and sells various equipment, including automated machines for automobile, electric, precision machine, film, medicine, electronic parts, and logistics industries. It also offers photovoltaic (PV) module manufacturing equipment, including cell testers, tabbing and stringing machines, layup machines, tape applicator, bussing machine, glass/sheet feeding machine, vacuum laminator, trimming machine, framing machine, j-box attachment/soldering/potting, inspection device, repair station, and buffer; vacuum bonding machines; and vacuum insulation panels sealing machines, etc. In addition, the company provides products and services related to PV panel inspection service, PV panel inspection device, PV panel reuse/recycling, PV panel disassembly equipment, etc. Further, the company sells vegetables cultivated in plant factory using artificial light. NPC Incorporated was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Fujishoji Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells gaming machines in Japan. The company offers pachinko and pachislot machines. It is also involved in the planning, development, sale, and distribution of digital content. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Hirata Corporation manufactures and sells various manufacturing line systems, industrial robots, and logistic equipment in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Automotive-Related; Semiconductor-Related; and Other Automated Labor-Saving Equipment. The company offers automotive related production equipment, such as electric vehicle related equipment, including electric drive units (EDU), gear box for EDU, rotors, stators, inverters, IGBT, battery modules, battery packs, and LIB charge discharged, as well as coating and drying; engine assembly, cylinder head assembly, and piston assembly lines; transmission related equipment comprising CVT assembly, automatic transmission assembly, and DCT assembly lines; and engine and component related equipment. It also provides semiconductor related equipment, including equipment front end modules/sorters, wafer transfer robots, aligners, load ports, and SMIF openers; and panel manufacturing systems, such as coater systems, glass cutting systems, coating and lamination systems, and auto-loader systems. In addition, the company offers industrial robot equipment comprising cartesian, SCARA-type, articulated, and substrate transfer robots, as well as 3D vision systems, robot controllers, teach pendants, and robot simulators; electronics and electrical appliance production equipment that includes home electronics related automated assembly lines, and electronic components and others; and power modules consisting of mounters, vacuum reflow ovens, and ultrasonic welders. Further, it provides sorting/stocking systems, stacker cranes, and traceability systems for production management; and medical/chemistry and physics devices, such as pathological tissue specimen preparation devices and cell destructive equipment, as well as ecoelectric series. Hirata Corporation was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Kumamoto, Japan.

Pegasus Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial sewing machines in Japan, China, Bangladesh, India, rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Apparel Machinery Business and Automotive Business segments. The company offers overlock and safety stitch, interlock and double chain stitch, automatic and labor-saving unit, and non-apparel industrial sewing machines. It also produces and sells automotive parts comprising seat belt, antenna, lamp, harness, auto door, door mirror, auxiliary lamp, headlight, wiper, and display parts. The company was formerly known as Pegasus Sewing Machine Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Pegasus Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Pegasus Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Marumae Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, processes, and assembles precision machinery. The company's products include vacuum chambers, shower heads, exhaust plates, electrostatic chucks, heaters, upper electrodes, and targets, as well as parts for transfer systems and other vacuum components used in etching, CVD, coater/developers, sputtering, single wafer cleaning, ashing, wafer bonding, ion implantation, and annealing. It also designs, manufactures, and sells precision machine parts; inspects and repairs precision machine parts and machine equipment, as well as is involved in the fitting and sheet-metal activities. In addition, the company designs, manufactures, and sells industrial and medical equipment; and manufactures and sells aluminum ingots, billets, slabs, and alloys. Further, it engages in the development and sale of software; plate working and plumbing; transportation; and real estate leasing businesses. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Izumi, Japan.

CONVUM Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of pneumatic equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers vacuum ejectors; vacuum suction pads; pressure sensors; vacuum robot hand, including balloon hand, e-hand, palletizer, kraft paper bag suction hand, bag suction hand, large diameter pad hand, and robot hand kit; vacuum accessory, such as vacuum filter, work drop prevention check valve, miniature vacuum in-line filter, check valve, vacuum in-line filter with coupling, and ejector silencer; and other products comprising thin non-contact pad, vacuum switching valve, picking pad, and mini air cylinders. The company also provides vacuum pumps; and speed controllers, tubes, push-in connectors, and miniature air cylinders. The company was formerly known as Myotoku Ltd. and changed its name to CONVUM Ltd. in January 2022. CONVUM Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

Tazmo Co., Ltd., together with subsidiaries engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, rest of Asia, North America, and Europe. It operates in three segments: Process Equipment Business; Mold and Resin Molding Business; and Surface Treatment Equipment Business. The company offers semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including bonders/debonders, cleaning systems, CMP slurry distribution systems, coaters/developers, and phosphoric acid reclamation process equipment; clean transfer equipment, such as atmospheric and vacuum robots, and pre aligners; and nanoimprint fully automated mass production equipment. It also provides FPD manufacturing equipment comprising FDP/PLP and manual coaters; precision molding dies and plastic moldings, which include mold making, injection molding, emboss carrier tapes, and precision parts; and UV irradiation systems. In addition, the company offers liquid crystal displays and other electronic device peripherals; wafer support systems; color filter manufacturing equipment; and plating processing and circuit formation equipment. Tazmo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

General Packer Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various packaging machines and peripheral equipment, and food processing and confectionery production machinery in Japan and internationally. It provides pouch filling-sealing machines, automatic bag forming and filling-sealing machines, automatic N2 gas flushing filling-sealing machines, and special type automatics bag filling-sealing machines, as well as automatic tray and desiccant insert bag feeding packaging machines, non-instructive residual oxygen analyzers, and chocolate manufacturing machines. The company also offers flour packaging, pasta packaging, drip coffee packaging, rice packaging, stick packages outer packaging, intravenous solution bag packaging, ampoule filling gas substitution packaging, medical device packaging, health foods packaging, pet foods packaging, and seed and seedling packaging system. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Kitanagoya, Japan.

Nabtesco Corporation manufactures and sells industrial robot parts, construction machinery, railway vehicle brake systems, and automatic doors, aircraft parts, automobile brakes and drive controls, marine, and platform safety products in Japan and internationally. It offers precision reduction gear for component and gear head types; hydraulic equipment, such as traveling units for crawlers, control valves for mini excavators, and swing units for hydraulic excavators; railroad vehicle equipment, such as unit brakes, door operators, and brake operating units; and aircraft equipment comprising flight control actuation systems and high-voltage electric power distribution units. The company also provides air dryers and wedge brake chambers for commercial vehicles, and electric compressors for electric buses; marine vessel equipment; automatic doors and platform doors for buildings; prosthetic knee joints; rollators with speed control systems; and power assist units for wheelchairs. In addition, it offers condition monitoring with fail-safe equipment and diagnostic services for wind turbines, as well as wireless power and charging systems; and designs, manufacture, sales, maintenance, and repair of packaging machines, 3D model creation devices, textile machines, and related equipment. Nabtesco Corporation was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

MODEC, Inc. operates as engineering, procurement, construction and installation (EPCI) general contractor of floating production systems in Brazil, Guyana, Senegal, Cote d' Ivoire, Ghana, Mexico, and internationally. The company builds, leases, and operates floating production storage and offloading, as well as floating storage and offloading; tension leg platforms; production semi-submersible platforms; floating liquefied natural gas floating production facilities. It is also involved in the digital and analytics business; provision of supplier relationship management and supplier registration supply chain services. MODEC, Inc. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Rheon Automatic Machinery Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and supplies a range of food processing machines in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Food Processing Machinery Manufacturing and Sales Business, and Food Manufacturing and Sales Business. The company provides encrusting machines comprising single and multi-row models, options, and peripheral equipment; and bread making machines such as line; and related equipment for producing confectioneries, breads, savory, and pastry. It also offers automatic machinery services; technical services; and maintenance services, such as periodic inspection, overhaul, and maintenance workshop. In addition, it offers automatic filling machines, martian series, stress-free bread systems, pastry lines, extruders, and peripheral automation equipment; repair and maintenance services, and distributes purchased products including ovens, mixers, and packaging machines. Further, it produces and sells bread, confectionery, croissants, Danish pastries, pies, cookies, frozen roll-in dough, and natural yeast bread starters; and manufactures and sells aluminum castings, and develops, manufactures, and sells natural yeast bread starters. Rheon Automatic Machinery Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

SMC Corporation manufactures and sells automatic control equipment in Japan, the United States, China, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers air management system, directional control valves, air cylinders, rotary actuators/air grippers/magnet grippers, electric actuators/cylinders, vacuum equipment, air grippers for collaborative robots, compact compressor, air preparation equipment, modular F.R.L., pressure control equipment, booster regulators, lubrication equipment, gas generator, fittings and tubing, flow control equipment, speed controllers, silencers/exhaust cleaners/pressure gauges, and air blowing equipment. It also provides switches/sensors/controllers, static neutralization equipment/ionizers, industrial device communication equipment/wireless system, process valves, chemical valves/fittings and tubing/needle valves, process pumps/diaphragm pumps, temperature control equipment, process gas equipment AP tech, high vacuum equipment, industrial filters/sintered metal elements, pneumatic instrumentation equipment, hydraulic equipment, and specialized products for general use. In addition, the company offers clean series/low-particle generation, fluoropolymer equipment PVC equipment, series compatible with secondary batteries series 25A-, and copper, fluorine-free equipment series 20-; ISO, IO-link compatible, and ATEX compliant products; arc welding process and grease-free nitrogen (N2) compatible equipment; equipment for food manufacturing and semiconductor industries; and pickup contents. It serves automobiles, semiconductor/liquid crystal/electric, machine tool, food/beverages, physicochemical/medical/pharmaceutical, agriculture, energy, production facility, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Shoketsu Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SMC Corporation in April 1986. SMC Corporation was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

SiriusVision Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, sale, and technical support of image inspection machines, software, and related products in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the operation and sales of computer software; web and DX cloud service businesses; cloud service business; and after-sales services for precision printing machines and related materials and parts. The company was formerly known as Navitas Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SiriusVision Co., Ltd. in January 2021. SiriusVision Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Hosokawa Micron Corporation provides powder and plastic processing equipment in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers powder processing equipment for grinding, classifying, blending and drying powder materials and products used in various industries; dust collection equipment for environmental protection and product recovery; and chemical hazard prevention equipment for the protection of workers during pharmaceuticals development and manufacture. It also provides machines for milling, mixing, particle design, agglomeration, feed and discharge, laboratory technology, bag filters, protection and production isolation, and engineering, as well as after-sales, toll processing, analysis, and preventive maintenance services. In addition, the company is involved in the contract research, development, manufacture, and sale of new materials, cosmetics, and hair growth products based on nanocomposite particle technology. Further, the company engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and system engineering of multi-layered performance films for use in food packaging; protection of electronic equipment; and single-layer film manufacturing equipment. It provides its products for energy, IT, automobile, chemicals, minerals, pharmaceuticals, food, polymer drying/SSP, containment, and metal industries. The company was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Hirakata, Japan.

Union Tool Co. designs, manufactures, and sells of cutting tools, linear motion products, and metal machining equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers printed circuit board (PCB) drills/routers, ULF coatings, diamond coated routers, and P series ultra precision micro-hole drills; PCB tools-related equipment; carbide end mills; linear motion products; and crossed roller guide and optical glass scale measuring instruments. It also provides roll dies and incremental dies, rack dies, rolled products, screw manufacturing dies, coating rods, and forging tools, as well as myBeat wearable heart rate sensors, heart rate variability analysis tool, and remote watching radar for small room. The company was formerly known as Union Chemical Research Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Union Tool Co. in 1971. Union Tool Co. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Zuiko Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and maintains disposable hygiene product manufacturing systems in Japan and internationally. Its converting machines are used to produce baby and adult diapers, feminine napkins, and face masks, as well as pet sheets and nursing pads, incontinence pads. The company also offers medical equipment and intermediary medical systems; pet care products; recycling equipment; and equipment, systems, and related software products related to converting machines. Zuiko Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Oiles Corporation manufactures and sells bearings, structural equipment, and construction equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers bearing products, including plastic, resin, multi-layer, metal, and air bearing; dies and mold products; and slide shifters. The company also provides seismic isolators and vibration control devices, damping devices, and architectural products for bridges and buildings; and smoke exhaust/ ventilation systems. Oiles Corporation was founded in 1939 and is headquartered in Fujisawa, Japan.

Nissei ASB Machine Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, manufacturing, and distribution of production machines for PET and other plastic bottles worldwide. It provides stretch blow molding machines, molds, and auxiliary equipment and parts. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Komoro, Japan.

Seiko Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, sale, and maintenance of industrial machinery in Japan. It operates through five segments: Industrial Machinery Business, Cold Forging Business, Electrical Equipment Business, Vehicle-Related Business, and Real Estate Leasing Business. The company manufactures and sells packaging machinery products, sterilization equipment, food processing machinery, industrial machinery, and factory automation production systems, as well as cold forged products. It is also involved in the sale of electrical equipment, such as factory automation equipment, air conditioning equipment, refrigeration equipment, and solar power generation equipment; installation work of air conditioning equipment; sale of vehicles and related products; and real estate leasing, parking lot management, and car rental. Seiko Corporation was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

Sato Corporation engages in providing automatic identification solution products in Japan and internationally. It offers printers, consumables, hand labelers, primary labels, label printing tools, labels, magnetic card, IC tags, ribbons, tickets, ink, and maintenance services. The company also provides software solutions for printing and management of label/tag data; and technical servicing support. In addition, it is involved in market research, planning, development, design, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and sales promotion of automation solutions; planning and proposing solutions in the medical field; sales of mechatronics products and supply products; manufacturing and sale of industrial rubber products, synthetic resins, and RFID tags and labels; and development, manufacturing, and sales of RFID products and supply products; and product designing and package design consulting. It serves retail, manufacturing, food, transport, logistics, health care, chemicals industries. The company was formerly known as Sato Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Sato Corporation in January 2025. Sato Corporation was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Giken Ltd. manufactures and sells construction machinery in Japan and internationally. The company develops automated underground facilities and environmentally friendly construction solutions. The company also offers hydraulic pile press-in and extraction machines; clamp cranes; pile and unit runners; and special auxiliary equipment, including piler stages, flywheel-type pile augers, jet locks and jet nozzles, hoses, jet pipes, pile lasers, pile rollers, hose rollers, auger head replacement arm, casing scrapers, leveling jacks for reaction stands, module boxes, and spreader beams, as well as PPT System and Implant NAVI. In addition, it develops automated parking facilities, such as ECO Park, EV ECO Park, ECO Cycle, and MOBILE ECO Cycle; and provides a total support system, comprising operation trainings and lectures, various software, automation support, and machine rental. Further, the company offers press-in construction solutions, which include Gyropress, Combi-Gyro, Skip Lock, Non-staging, Overhead Clearance, Zero Clearance, Tubular Sheet Pile Press-in, and Concrete Sheet Pile Press-in methods; implant structures, such as Implant Levee, Implant Lock Levee, and Implant Bell Cap Bridge; and wall and foundation type solutions. Giken Ltd. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kochi, Japan.

Airtech Japan, Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells clean air systems in Japan. The company offers cleanrooms/BSL-3/CPF; air showers/pass boxes; clean booths/SS-MAC series/fan filter units; clean benches/biosafety cabinets/isolators; infection prevention products. It also provides air curtain/insect control/cold storage air curtains; cleanroom equipment and supplies; biohazard systems; and dust/chemical dust removal devices/deodorizing. Airtech Japan, Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

Kawata Mfg. Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures powder and particle processing equipment and systems in Japan, East Asia, China, Southeast Asia, North and Central America, and internationally. The company provides dehydrating, nitrogen, hot air, reduced pressure, and large PET resin crystal dryer; blenders, such as weighing, volumetric metering, and simple mixing types; and loaders, which consist of pellet conveying, powder conveying, and plug conveying. It also offers heating medium circulation temperature controllers, which consist of water medium temperature controller, water medium cold temperature controller, oil medium temperature controller, chillers, mold rapid cooling, and others; mixers, including high speed fluid mixing, high efficiency dry dispersion, cool mixing, and high speed floating mixing. In addition, the company provides granulators; silo tank, which comprises H series and flexible containment tank; dosage supply machines, nitrogen replacement machines, fine powder removal, pellet sorting, nitrogen gas generation, re-adsorption prevention machine, magnet, and filter washer products; system/plant equipment; colortronic equipment; and powder processing machines and systems, as well as equipment for battery, ceramic, fine chemical, food, cosmetics, drug, and paint industry. The comp Kawata Mfg. Co., Ltd. any was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Okada Aiyon Corporation engages in the manufacture, sale, and repair of construction machines in Japan. It offers hydraulic breakers, demolition crushers, demolition crushers/shears, demolition shears, demolition pulverizers, demolition and sorting grapples, vibratory hammers, hydraulic quick couplers, and recycling attachments. The company was formerly known as OKADA Rock Drill Co. and changed its name to Okada Aiyon Corporation in 1983. Okada Aiyon Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. provides mechatronics, display, industrial machinery, and electronics related products in Japan and internationally. It offers burnishing systems, UV curing equipment, hard disk and semiconductor conveyor systems, automated handling machines, semiconductor handlers, Peltier systems, conveyor and bagging lines, factory automation equipment, and solar water and cell manufacturing and research and development tools; automated machinery business carrier tape business electronic components business; laser business ion beam business; hair analysis, biomarker analysis, and Eliza kit business; and shirt finishing system, wool finisher, uniform finishers, tumbler, bagging system, distributor, apparel equipment, and maintenance support. The company also provides precision polishing systems, handling technology solutions, cutting technology equipment, precision machining systems, laser technology equipment, and chemical solution application technology; medical products, healthcare products, electronic devices, printer-related equipment, fully automated hair mounting machines, fully automated hair slicing machines, and disease analysis technology solutions; and control technology systems, communication technology systems, general measurement equipment, optical measurement equipment, clothing drying, pressing and packaging equipment, mold heaters, and optical automatic double-sided inspection systems. Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Y.A.C. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2017. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Akishima, Japan.

Komatsu Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of construction, mining, utility, forestry, and industrial machinery worldwide. It operates in three segments: Construction Machinery and Vehicles, Retail Finance, and Industrial Machinery and Others. The company offers construction and mining equipment, such as hydraulic and mini excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, dump trucks, rope and hybrid shovels, continuous miners, and jumbo drills; and demolition, waste, and recycling equipment, including mini shovels, mobile crushers, and hydraulic excavators with a cutter, pulverizer, and magnet. It also provides forklifts and motor graders; excavators with harvesting head, mini excavators with grapple, harvesters, forwarders, and feller bunchers; counterbalance type electric forklifts and internal combustion forklifts; and industrial machinery equipment comprising presses, transfer machines, battery manufacturing equipment, wire saws, thermo modules, thermoelectric generation module, EH sensor device, temperature control products, and press brakes and laser cutting sheet-metal machinery. In addition, the company offers industry equipment consisting of tunnel boring machines, pipe layers, towing tractors, and engines. Further, it is involved in rent construction machinery; lease a portion of the land and building; businesses related to transportation, warehousing, and packaging; sale financing for mining machinery; and development, sale, and servicing of forging and sheet metal. Komatsu Ltd. was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Sumitomo Heavy Industries, Ltd. manufactures and sells general machinery worldwide. It operates through four segments: Mechatronics, Industrial Machinery, Logistics & Construction, and Energy & Lifelines. The Mechatronics segment offers gearmotors, gearboxes, motion control drives, motors and inverters, drive solutions, precision positioning equipment, control systems, motion components, cryocoolers, and cryopumps. Its Industrial Machinery segment provides Plastics machinery, film forming machines, precision forgings, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, accelerators, medical machines and equipment, forging press machines, air-conditioning equipment, and defense equipment. The Logistics & Construction segment offers Hydraulic excavators, mobile cranes, road machinery, material handling systems, logistics systems, and automated parking systems. Its Energy & Lifelines segment provides power generation equipment, air pollution control equipment, water and sewage treatment systems, turbines, pumps, mixing vessels, food processing machinery, ships, and marine structures. The company was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction machineries in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Russia, CIS, Africa, the Middle East, the Asia-Pacific, and China. The company operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Business and Specialized Parts and Service Business. It offers excavators and wheel loaders, hydraulic excavators, compaction equipment, and rigid dump trucks. The company also provides ICT construction solutions; ConSite that monitors machines' operational status and alarms by sending monthly operational reports, as well as notifies emergency alarms; Fleet Management System, which offers real-time monitoring of dump truck for optimizing vehicle operations; and Autonomous Haulage System for mining operations. In addition, it provides parts and services; used equipment under the PREMIUM USED brand; machinery rental services under the PREMIUM RENTAL and REC brand names; and parts remanufacturing services. Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

Nikko Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixing and concrete batching plants in Japan, China, and internationally. The company operates through Concrete Plant Related Business; Environment and Transportation Related Business; Crusher Related Business; and Manufacturing Contract Related Business segments. It offers asphalt mixing plants, including main units, aggregate supply units, combustion units, dust collectors, asphalt supply systems, and control systems; hot mix silo, filler silo, and dust mixers; and recycling, exhaust gas treatment, deodorization, and crushing systems. The company also provides concrete batching plants comprising air seal, automatic cleaning, and waste-water treatment systems, as well as control panels and water-pressure devices; and mixers. In addition, it offers belt conveyor systems; beverage container recycling, plastic recycling, and soil remediation plants; environmental equipment; and system control panels and software, as well as maintenance services and remote control systems. The company was formerly known as Nihon Kogu Product Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nikko Co., Ltd. in February 1968. Nikko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Akashi, Japan.

Sansei Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, installs, rents, maintains, repairs, and sells washing gondola for cleaning windows in mid and high-rise buildings in Japan. The company also provides stage equipment, amusement machines, scaffolding and moving equipment for cleaning, banner systems, electric gates, and other various transport and lifting devices. In addition, it is involved in lease and rent of gondolas; build and repair ships. Further, the company engages in the manufacture, sell, and repair artificial reefs; design and consulting for transport and handling machinery; handling of aluminum building materials; metalwork; and consulting on building maintenance and renovation business. Sansei Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Tomoe Engineering Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells chemicals, machinery, and equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers plastics, fine chemicals, minerals, and industrial, advanced, and electronic materials for various applications, including packing/conveyance, adhesion, water sealing/waterproofing, industrial materials, electronic materials/device, related parts, coating, grinding, measurement, jigs/tools, painting, and others. It also provides centrifuges, rotary snails, gravity belt thickener, and grinder for impurities for wastewater and sludge treatment, food, animal feed, pharmaceuticals, chemistry, recycling, energy, steel making, biology, civil engineering, and architecture industries. The company also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Iseki & Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of agricultural machinery in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It offers cultivating machineries, including tractors, tillers, high clearance multipurpose vehicles, and mowers; planting machinery, such as rice and vegetable transplanters; and harvesting machinery comprising combine harvesters and binders. The company also provides processing machinery, such as rice hullers, dryers, rice cleaners, rice graders, vegetable harvesting, and processing machinery; and implements, spare parts, agricultural facilities, as well as diesel engine. Iseki & Co., Ltd. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Arakawa, Japan.

TOWA Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-precision molds in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, Medical Device, and Laser Processing Equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment manufactures and sells precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing, molding equipment, singulation equipment, etc.; and provides aftersale services. The Medical Device segment manufactures and sells medical devices and other products. The Laser Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of laser processing equipment and provision of aftersale services. It also offers precision molds, end mills and drill series, TEN-systems, and mold release films. The company was formerly known as TOWA Precision Industries Limited and changed its name to TOWA Corporation in December 1988. TOWA Corporation was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Maruyama Mfg. Co., Inc. manufactures and sells machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers agricultural machines, such as brush cutters, furrow trimmers, riding and self-propelled grass cutters, power sprayers, backpack portable power sprayers, manual pest control machines, power spreaders, ditch cutters, aerial and electric work platforms, and rice related products; riding and large pest control machines, including stereo and boom sprayers, high creation boom, multirotor for liquid spraying, multi and shuttle sprayers, and freshhousers; green related products, comprising chainsaws, hedge trimmers, blowers, chippers, and shredders; pumps, cleaning machines, and mist generators, such as pump motor sets, industrial pumps, high pressure washers, and disinfection equipment; and fire extinguishers and disaster prevention equipment. It also provides ultra fine bubble related products, which includes ultra pumps, washing machines, ultra coolant freshers, mounted generators, and general water supply installation; power spreaders; agricultural drones; and engine pumps and cleaners. In addition, the company involved in the contract design, construction of plumbing, and real estate and leasing activities. It was formerly known as Maruyama Shokai and changed its name to Maruyama Mfg. Co., Inc. in 1937. Maruyama Mfg. Co., Inc. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Kitagawa Corporation manufactures and supplies synthetic metals, machine tool accessories, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers standard and advanced chucks, jaw force testers, manual chucks, rotary cylinders, chuck parts, NC rotary tables, power vises, work grippers, robot accessories, vise parts, and other peripheral equipment for machine tools such as turning centres and vertical machining centres. It also provides tower cranes for building construction, concrete mixing plants, multi-story car parking, and bridge erection machines, as well as recycling plants; and components for automotive industry. The company was formerly known as Kitagawa Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Corporation in June 2018. Kitagawa Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

Tacmina Corporation manufactures and sells pump products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers smoothflow pumps; motor-driven metering pumps, including direct drive diaphragm, hydraulic diaphragm, and plunger metering pumps, as well as V; solenoid-driven metering pumps; and metering pump accessories, such as relief valves, back pressure valves, injection valves, air chambers/dumpers, pulse-emitting flowmeter/flow indicator/discharge amount checkers, pressure gauges, residual pressure release valves, degassing connectors, strainer-foot valves, float switch-level measurement, suction valves, hose/connector types, pump frames/covers, and parts kits. It also provides chemical injection systems; chemical tanks comprising solution, diluted sulfuric acid solution, PE, PVC, and iron-frame PVC tanks; vertical, horizontal, and transportable agitators; static mixers; and units and systems. In addition, the company offers liquid analysis and testing services, as well as device rental services. It serves the battery and electronic, film, chemical and biochemical, iron and metal, ink, coating, ceramic, plastic and rubber, pharmaceutical and cosmetic, food and drink, water treatment, and sterilization industries. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Rorze Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of automation systems for the semiconductor and flat panel display production worldwide. The company offers wafer handling systems, including atmospheric robots, vacuum wafer robots, aligners, load ports, vacuum platforms, EFEMs/sorters, and stockers; and mask/reticle handling systems. It also provides system integration and package service, as well as host online communication, equipment control, and EDA/interface A solutions; and control devices, such as controllers, and stepping motors and drivers. In addition, the company offers life science automation products comprising mechatronics CO2 incubators, cell keepers, twist decappers and incubators, heat sealers, power seals, varistocks, and cell farms and shots. Further, it is involved in manufacturing of robot for semiconductor production equipment; the processing and export of machinery parts for robots; and importing, selling, maintaining, and broking equipment and parts. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Fukuyama, Japan.

Harmonic Drive Systems Inc. manufacturing and sales of speed reducers and mechatronics products in Japan, China, North America, and Europe. It offers mechatronics products, including rotary and linear actuators, speed reducers, motors, sensors system, servo drivers, optical galvano scanner, and other system elements. The company also provides HarmonicDrive, a precision speed reducer; high-precision planetary speed reducers under the AccuDrive and HarmonicPlanetary brands; and high-performance gear heads for servo motors series under HarmonicGearhead. Its products are used in industrial robots, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and other systems. Harmonic Drive Systems Inc. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Takakita Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of agricultural machinery in Japan and internationally. The company provides grass and straw packing machine, such as mini, self-propelled mini, variable diameter, and round balers; round baler for chopped material, chopping combi bale wrapper, general-purpose type forage harvesting-baler, and chopping whole crop harvesting-baler; mini, automatic, remote control, and self-propelled bale wrapper; and combi bale wrappers. It also offers fertilizing and machinery. The company was formerly known as Takakita Agricultural Machinery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takakita Co., Ltd. in 1988. Takakita Co., Ltd. was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Nabari, Japan.

Kubota Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of agricultural and construction machinery in Japan, North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers tractors, power tillers, combine harvesters, rice transplanters, turf equipment, utility vehicles, other agricultural machineries, implements, attachments, post-harvest machineries, vegetable production equipment, intermediate management machines, and other equipment for agricultural use, weighing and measuring control systems, and cooperative drying, rice seedling, and gardening facilities, as well as rice mill plants. It also provides farm equipment, construction machinery, industrial machinery, and generators engines; and mini excavators, wheel loaders, compact track loaders, skid steer loaders, and other construction machinery-related products. In addition, the company offers ductile iron pipe, plastic pipe, valves, single stack drain fittings, and design and construction of construction works; reformer and cracking tubes, hearth rolls, TXAX, steel pipe piles, steel pipe sheet piles, and air-conditioning equipment; wastewater treatment equipment and plants, pumps and plants, membrane solutions, water purification plants, night-soil treatment plants, waste incinerating and melting plants, waste shredding and sorting plants, flue gas desulfurization apparatus, membrane methane fermentation plants, wastewater treatment plant, and valves sector. Further, it is involved in the provision of roofing, siding materials and rain gutters; logistics, retail financing, and finance leasing services; export and import of components for farm equipment, engines, and construction machinery; underwriting non-life insurance; design and construction of water and sewage; civil engineering; management of logistics and logistics information service; and building maintenance, security guarding, and facility management. Kubota Corporation was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of press machines, factory automation equipment, and transfer machines. The company offers hot laminating press related machinery used for fabrication of printed circuit boards, mobile communication, home appliances, automobiles, satellites, and resin forming applications. It also provides automatic stacking machines for carbon fiber reinforced thermoplastic laminates used in aviation and automobile industries and unidirectional continuous fiber materials; laminators for laminating solar panels, on-board solar light panels, curved glass, touch panels, decorative glass plates, etc.; and solid stockers, automated warehouse systems, floor lifts, and special machinery. The company was formerly known as Kotobuki Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. in September 1960. Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmentally related products. The company operates through Manufacturing, Engineering, and Trading business segments. The company offers manufacturing businesses, such as ozone concentration meters, ozone application equipment, industrial deodorizers and deodorizing equipment, energy-saving blowers, water treatment related equipment, infectious disease prevention products, aquaculture related products, and ZEB/ZEH related products. It also offers engineering businesses, such as water and sewage treatment facilities, including water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, various pumping stations; related design, construction, and maintenance of machinery and electrical equipment; and cloud-based remote monitoring and control system E-Qias Cloud, water supply facilities, sewerage facilities, storm water drainage pumping station facility, manhole pump facility. In addition, the company is involved in trading business, such as pumps, blowers, air conditioning, building piping restoration work, energy, water supply degassing and ionization devices, steel structure, crusher, and spirion; and purchases and sells air conditioning equipment, cooling and heating equipment, etc. related to air conditioning equipment, water supply and drainage, sanitary equipment, etc., and construction related to the equipment. Further, it provides waste liquid/waste recycling equipment, waste sorting equipment, and waste treatment equipment; medical devices, chemicals, and reagents; contracts and executes civil engineering, building construction, electrical work, plumbing, steel structures, painting, machinery and equipment installation, and other construction work; real estate leasing and management activities; animal feed and organic fertilizers; leasing and rental business; industrial waste disposal business; and temporary staffing business. Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toyo Engineering Corporation engages in the engineering and construction of industrial facilities in Japan, India, China, and internationally. It also provides various services, such as research and development support, planning, technical research, design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical assistance for industrial facilities, including oil and gas, petrochemicals and chemicals, water treatment, power generation, advanced production systems, pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals, biotechnology, environmental solutions, resource development, artificial intelligence. Toyo Engineering Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction of various industrial and chemical plants and environmental control facilities in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Engineering and Machinery segments. The Engineering segment includes city gas and petroleum related plants, chemical engineering plants, hydrogen generation plants, sewage treatment equipment, industrial effluent treatment equipment, diverse water treatment equipment, corrosion resistant containers made of fiber-reinforced plastic (FRP) and other products. The Machinery segment offers oil purifiers, separators and filtration machinery, seawater screening facility, mixers and related products. The company also provides belt dehydrators, cleaners, concentrators, strainers, heat exchangers, towers, vessels, ballast water treatment systems, dryers, filters, and SOx scrubber systems. The company was formerly known as Kakoki Seisaku, Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. in 1938. Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

Tsukishima Holdings Co., Ltd. provides products and services for water and sewer facilities in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates through, Water Environment Business and Industrial Business segments. The company offers chemical injection, water treatment, and dehydration systems, as well as plant facilities including digestion tanks and incinerators; and pressure vessels and heat exchangers. It also engages in the design, manufacture, and construction services for water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, biomass usage facilities, and sludge recycling facilities; operating public-private partnership projects, including project finance initiative, design-build-operate, and digestive gas power generation projects; operational management and repair services to water and sewer facilities. In addition, the company is involved in sale of industrial chemicals; sale of machinery and supplies for environmental equipment; design, manufacture, and sale of plant systems and equipment for advanced fields comprising battery components and life science fields, such as pharmaceuticals, food products, and cosmetics; and waste treatment business; design, manufacture, and sale of equipment to contribute to environmental improvements and various chemical and general industrial equipment. Further, it engages in waste collection, transport, and intermediate treatment, and thermal recycling through alternative energy power generation; printing and bookbinding of drawings and general documents; and real estate management and leasing. The company was formerly known as Tsukishima Kikai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tsukishima Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Tsukishima Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Teikoku Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical and general machinery and equipment. It offers canned motor pumps; metering pumps; canned motor agitators; electric oil pumps; protection devices for canned motor pumps; high temperature molten salt circulation pumps; sealless gas blower for SF6 gas; rotating direction indicator for motors; and roll stabilizer motors, as well as spare parts. The company also provides inspection, on-site and in-house repair, and maintenance services, as well as after-sales services. Its products are used in various fields, such as fine chemical, pharmaceutical, food industries, petrochemical plants, nuclear power plants, and electrical substations. The company operates in Japan, the United States, China, Taiwan, Singapore, Germany, India, and South Korea. The company was formerly known as Teikoku Electric Mfg.Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Teikoku Corporation in April 2026. Teikoku Corporation was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Tatsuno, Japan.

Meiji Machine Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells machines used in food industries in Japan and internationally. The company offers mills, classification machines, separators, mixers, receiving and transportation equipment, pneumatic machinery, and fluting and grinding machines.
