It also provides microwave tempering tunnel oven system; food tempering tunnel microwave system; batch processing microwave oven; mini batch microwave tempering oven (MIP4); mini batch microwave tempering oven (MIP3); and industrial microwave systems. The company was formerly known as Yamakoshi Machinery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Meiji Machine Co., Ltd. in 1948. Meiji Machine Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho, Ltd. manufacture and sells printing machines and press control systems in Japan, Asia, and North America. The company offers factory automation; processing and assembly; newspaper rotary press; and automation and labor-saving equipment/systems, including automatic paper threading device, automatic plate loading and unloading device, printing air conditioning system, newspaper production control system, and production management control system. It also provides newspaper and commercial printing press peripherals, such as automatic register control device, cutoff control system, paper monitoring device, X system, spray dampening system, newspaper production control system, monitorproof system, and automatic ink and dampening solution control system; rotary printing press maintenance services; power generation and electricity sale; and digital and newspaper printing. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Kikai Seizou Company, Ltd. and changed its name to Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho, Ltd. in January 1916. Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho, Ltd. was founded in 1874 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Ishii Hyoki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electrical machinery and peripheral electronic machinery parts in Japan. The company operates through electronic device parts manufacturing equipment, display and electronic components, and other divisions. It offers devices, such as graphic operation panel LCD systems; switch panel units; silk printing, label printing, and alumite nameplates; film formation products; printed circuit board parts; and precision sheet metal processing products. The company also provides polishing and surfacing machines for use in the production of printed circuit boards, FPCs, and electronic parts; and deburring machines for use in the surface treatment of clutch discs, brake pads, and other automobile parts. In addition, it offers PI inkjet systems for liquid crystal displays, as well as related maintenance services. The company serves electronics and automobile industries. Ishii Hyoki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Fukuyama, Japan.

TESEC Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor test equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers DC static characteristics and inductive load one-pass test system for SiC/GaN power semiconductors; power device test system; IPD/IPM test system; thermal resistance tester; inductive load tester; and dynamic test system. It also provides various handlers comprising tri-temp lead frame strip test, film frame test, gravity, MEMS, and TAB handlers, as well as die sorters. In addition, it offers after-sales services, such as tester calibration, overhaul, and training services, as well as spare parts, warranty, maintenance, and resale services. The company was formerly known as TES Corporation and changed its name to TESEC Corporation in 1980. TESEC Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Higashiyamato, Japan.

Takatori Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and liquid crystal related equipment, multi wire saws and textile machinery, and medical devices primarily in Japan and internationally. The company offers precision cutting machinery for sapphire, SiC, and GaN substrates; solar panels; quartz crystals; LT and LN products; GaAs, Gap, and InP products; magnets; ceramics; and materials for research and development. It also provides semiconductor equipment for LED/RF devices, TAIKO processes, wafer protection tape lamination and removal machines, wafer mounters, UV irradiation equipment, film resist lamination machines, package mounters, substrate(H-WSS) processing equipment, and MEMS. In addition, the company provides display equipment for LCD panel surface cleaning, polarizer attaching, and touch panel bonding process machines; vacuum lamination for large substrates; carbon fiber/thin film solar cell sheet and apparel-related textile equipment; and medical devices. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Kashihara, Japan.

Sintokogio,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells foundry, surface treatment, casting, environmental, conveying, special machinery, and other equipment in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in electronic core materials and ceramics businesses. It also offers green sand and v-process molding, chemically bonded sand, and aluminium casting products; dust collection and fire prevention system, exhaust gas and water treatment products; powder treatment products and technologies; and force sensors. In addition, it provides flooring and electric cylinders, as well as image processing measuring machines and calibration of measuring instruments and machines. Further, it provides shot and air blasting machines, shot peening machines, barrel and precision brush polishing equipment, high-precision micro-machining equipment, surface evaluation equipment, surface treatment parts, abrasives, polishing, materials, etc.; mold molding and V process equipment, core molding and casting sand treatment equipment, and automatic pouring and sand coating equipment; casting equipment and parts, powder and granular processing equipment, wear-resistant castings, etc; dust collectors, deodorizers, wastewater treatment equipment, VOC gas purification equipment, and environmental business components; lifting devices, step-climbing machines; and organic EL panel manufacturing equipment and automated lines. Additionally, it provides dispersizers, battery raw material supply equipment, 3D equipment, 3D printers, ceramic products, molding equipment, automotive door assembly equipment, metal magnetic powders, sterile environment provision equipment; and special machinery business parts, nursing care and welfare products, etc. The company was formerly known as Kubota Seisakusho, Ltd. and changed its name to Sintokogio,Ltd. in February 1960. Sintokogio,Ltd. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Shibuya Corporation manufactures and sells packaging and other systems in Japan and internationally. The company offers bottling systems for SAKE and distilled spirit bottling system, liquor bottling system, beer bottling system, dairy product bottling system, seasoning bottling system, cooking oil bottling system, cosmetics bottling system, personal care products bottling system, chemical product bottling system, health and nutritional drink bottling system, and mineral water bottling system; and packaging systems, such as caser/uncaser, wrap-around caser, cartoning machine, case former, case sealing, multi packer, cup filling/sealing, cup and tray sealing, pouch filling and sealing, gusset packaging, corrugate sheet providing, container folding assembly, polyethylene film applicator, poly bag sealing, and packaging system machines. It also provides pharmaceutical manufacturing systems, including isolator systems, sterilization/decontamination systems, filling systems, validation, preparation facilities, and various pharmaceutical manufacturing systems; regenerative medicine manufacturing systems; food processing systems; and production management systems. In addition, the company offers fiber laser cutting; CO2 laser cutting; YAG laser welding, laser ablation, laser/water cutting, water jet cutting, and other cutting machines, as well as hydraulic presses; solder ball mounter, bonders for optical communication and optical devices, flip chip bonders/high-accuracy die bonders, high-accuracy bonders for image sensors, wire bonder, LED inspection/sorting/taping machines, battery manufacturing system; and battery manufacturing systems; medical equipment systems; cleaning / environmental equipment systems; and agricultural equipment systems, as well as engineering services for equipment and plants. Shibuya Corporation was founded in 1931 and is based in Kanazawa, Japan.

Taihei Machinery Works, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of plywood machinery, woodworking machinery, and building materials for home applications in Japan. It operates through three segments: Plywood Machinery Business, Woodworking Machinery Business, and Housing Materials Business. The company offers artesa, dryer, and horizontal hot press products, including Knife Grinder ARTESA I V94-AC and Knife Honer ARTESA II V95-AC; Roll Jet Dryer/SRJ-125; Type VF-5(4) Vacuum Pre-feeder; Horizontal Hot Press/P25-AB; and Automatic Infeed Device IRETARO/P91-AB. It also provides T-Scanner DX, which measures the condition of wood by scanning it with a laser camera, and extracts defects, such as its shape, knots, and insect damage; and finger jointing system. In addition, the company manufactures underfeed chipper, repier, and shaker. Further, it sells and renovates custom-built house; and sells wooden building materials for construction. Taihei Machinery Works, Limited was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Komaki, Japan.

Freesia Macross Corporation engages in the real estate transaction, lease and rental, and supervision business in Japan. It also manufactures, processes, imports, exports, and sells machines and electric equipment. In addition, the company offers twin and single screw extruders, cooling water baths, twin tower dryers, pelletizers, classifiers, catcher tanks, twin screw feeders, side feeders, die face cutters, screen changers, and vacuum pumps. Further, it develops, imports, exports, and sells foods and beverages; musical instruments, toys, and stationeries; lumber, porcelain, and ceramics; textiles for clothing; jewelries; and sports goods. Additionally, the company repairs, installs, leases, and rents machinery equipment; manufactures and sells plastic resin materials, miscellaneous plastic goods, pipes, and sheets; and acquires, sells, and patents industrial rights, know-how, and software, as well as imports, exports, and sells miscellaneous goods. Additionally, the company is involved in the construction works planning, designing, contracting, supervising, and sub-contracting activities; and hotel, sport facilities, restaurant, and travel agency businesses. The company was formerly known as Macross Company Ltd. and changed its name to Freesia Macross Corporation in April 1995. Freesia Macross Corporation was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Freesia Macross Corporation is a subsidiary of Freesia House Co., Ltd.

Aichi Corporation manufactures and sells mechanized vehicles for electric utilities, telecommunications, construction, cargo handling, shipbuilding, and rail industries in Japan, Asia, Oceania, Europe, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Aichi Sharyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Aichi Corporation in 1992. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Ageo, Japan.

Kikukawa Enterprise, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of woodworking machines and machine tools in Japan. It also offers sawmill machine; plywood finishing machine/inspection machine; wide belt sander; and moisture meter products, such as non-destructive high frequency wood and wood chip moisture meter. The company was formerly known as Kikukawa Iron Works, Inc. and changed its name to Kikukawa Enterprise, Inc. in October 2012. Kikukawa Enterprise, Inc. was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Ise, Japan.

Placo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells plastic molding machines and recycling equipment in Japan. The company offers blow molding machines, such as in-die accumulator, continuous extrusion, electric, multilayer and two way switchable 3D duct blow molding machines and environmental equipment; high-performance extruder, multilayer inflation molding machine, high performance winding machine, multi-layer inflation die, air ring for controlling uneven wall thickness, barrier film thickness measurement system, and internal cooling system. It also provides environmental equipment such as single and twin shaft shredder, high speed pulverizer, and recycled pellet machine; other related products; blown film molding machine; and maintenance business. The company was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

Tsurumi Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. produces, imports, exports, sells, and leases submersible pumps, environmental equipment, and related machinery in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company provides water pumps, including portable dewatering, dewatering, slurry, portable residue dewatering, corrosion-resistant, seawater-resistant dewatering, explosion-proof dewatering, pumps for high temperature liquids and sewage bypass, engine-driven dewatering, self-priming residue dewatering, cast iron, resin-made, seawater-resistant sewage, stainless steel, cast stainless steel, titanium, submersible axial flow, submersible mixed flow, domestic pumps, vertical multistage in-line, and horizontal multistage. It also offers float switches and generators; water treatment equipment, including aeration equipment, scum skimmers, decanters, screening equipment, and dehydrators; liquid ring pumps; and liquid level sensors. Its products are used in construction and mining, civil engineering, industry and energy, agriculture and irrigation, river and flood control, waterworks and wastewater, and environmental protection fields. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Nippon Gear Co., Ltd. provides manufacturing and selling of various types of gears and related maintenance services Japan and internationally. The company offers electric and manual valve actuators under Nippon Gear and Flowserve Limitorque brand names; trapezoidal and ball screw jacks, and other jacks; vertical and horizontal mixers; cylindrical gears; speed-up gears; straight and spiral bevel gears; hypoid gears; gear measurement equipment; encoders; digital controllers; and fan drives. It is also involved in designing, manufacturing, and sale of measuring instruments, data transmission instruments, control equipment, and software; installation, maintenance, repair, and inspection of valve actuators, reduction gears, speed-up gears, mixers, jacks, measuring instruments, data transmission instruments, and control equipment. In addition, the company designs, supervise, and implement machinery and equipment installation and electrical works. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Sansei Technologies, Inc. plans, designs, manufactures, installs, repairs, and maintains amusement rides, stage equipment, elevators, and other designed equipment in Japan, North America, the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company's amusement rides include dark rides, omnimovers, observation towers, boat rides, flume rides, tea cup rides, sky journey rides, train rides, roller coasters, and thrill rides. It also provides stage equipment, such as floor mechanisms comprising elevators for stage (Seri), orchestra, and revolving stage systems. In addition, the company offers rigging systems for raising and lowering the scenery sets, lighting, audio and screen equipment, stage curtains, backdrops, etc.; acoustic equipment; control systems; and stage equipment for small halls, adaptable stages, event halls, sports halls, and studios. Further, it provides property management and logistics services; repair and maintenance services; operates and manages amusement facilities; and rents electric and mechanical equipment for TV programs, concerts, stages, events, etc. The company was formerly known as Sansei Yusoki Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sansei Technologies, Inc. in January 2014. Sansei Technologies, Inc. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Sakai Heavy Industries, Ltd. manufactures and sells of construction equipment and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers soil compactors, such as vibratory single drum rollers; asphalt rollers, including static three wheel rollers, static pneumatic tire rollers, vibratory tandem rollers, and combined rollers; road maintenance equipment, comprising road cutter, road planner, and soil stabilizers, water sprinkler, and cold recyclers; and light equipment, which include walk behind rollers, plate compactors, and rammers. It is also involved in the sale of outsourced industrial machinery. The company was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Tokyo Automatic Machinery Works, Ltd. designs, develops, produces, and sells various types of packaging machines in Japan, America, Europe, Ireland, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company also offers cigarette manufacturing and packaging machinery; baling systems; and automatic laborsaving machines and systems. In addition, it provides confectionary and gift wrapping machines; premade pouch packaging machine; powder filling machine; film overwrapping machines; turnkey packaging line; cardboard caser; palletizer; cardboard case formers; case-sealing machines; cartoner; paper product overwrapping machine; tobacco machine; special-item wrapping machines; baling system series; vibrating conveyor; and production machines. The company was formerly known as Shimane Manufacturing Co. and changed its name to Tokyo Automatic Machinery Works, Ltd. in 1949. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Ebara Corporation manufactures and sells pumps, compressors, turbines, and chillers in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Japan, Oceania, North America, and Central and South America. It operates through the Building Service & Industrial, Energy, Infrastructure, Environmental Solutions, and Precision Machinery segments. The company offers standard and custom pumps, fans, booster pump units, chillers, cooling towers, and heating and cooling machines; and cryogenic products. It also provides incineration systems, gasification technologies, municipal and industrial waste treatment plants, municipal waste processing plants, and boilers, as well as sewerage and drainage treatment systems. In addition, the company offers chemical mechanical polishing systems, CMP equipment, dry vacuum pumps, gas abatement systems, plating equipment, exhaust-gas treatment equipment, and ozonized water generators. Ebara Corporation was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Torishima Pump Mfg. Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of pumps and peripheral equipment in Japan and internationally. It provides end-suction, double-suction, multi-stage, large, and specialized pumps; and mechanical seals, including single and multi-spring component, cartridge, and split seals. The company also offers installation, maintenance, and operator training services; management and operation of the pumping facilities; re-engineering and design up, hydraulic parts upgrade, and coating services; and inspection and maintenance services. In addition, it engages in the design, engineering, procurement, construction, and commission of pumping stations; and provides engineering solutions for wind power generation systems, as well as wind assessment and location surveys, such as business plans, design, installation, and maintenance advisory services; and support services for installed wind power facilities. Further, the company is involved in reuse of wastewater energy; and wind power generation systems business. Torishima Pump Mfg. Co., Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Takatsuki, Japan.

Airman Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of construction machinery, and industrial machinery including construction equipment in Japan and internationally. The company also engages in the manufacture and sale of air compressors under the AIRMAN brand. In addition, the company offers engine compressors, engine generators, aerial work platforms, motor compressors, emergency generators, scissors lifters, and mini excavators. The company was formerly known as Hokuetsu Industries Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Airman Corporation in April 2025. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Tsubame, Japan.

DMW Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of fluid machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers pumps, fans, blowers, valves, energy recovery devices, eco turbines, rotating disc devices, underwater sand removal robots, and related equipment. It also provides agricultural and tunnel ventilation equipment; wastewater treatment and waste treatment equipment; switchboards, electrical instrumentation, and telecommunications control devices; equipment related to dredging and dredging works; and energy recovery devices for seawater desalination. In addition, the company offers planning, designing, supervision, and installation services for various equipment; and manages and leases real estate properties. Further, it provides investment and financial services to other businesses. DMW Corporation was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

Chiyoda Corporation engages in the integrated engineering business in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It provides consulting, planning, design, construction, procurement, commissioning, and maintenance services for various plants, industrial and residential, and facilities related to gas, electricity, petroleum, petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, pollution prevention, environment and disaster preservation, and others. The company also explores oil, gas, and other mineral resources, as well as invests in and finances exploration activities; design, procurement, and installation of equipment and machinery; engages in civil engineering, construction, and piping work; commissioning; and all other related businesses. Chiyoda Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Daikin Industries,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells air conditioning and refrigeration equipment in Japan, the United States, China, Europe, Asia, Oceania, and internationally. The company offers split/multi-split type air conditioners, unitary, air to water heat pump systems, heating systems, air purifiers, medium/low temperature refrigeration, packaged air conditioners, VRV, ventilation products, control systems, container refrigeration units, air and water cooled chillers, rooftops, air side equipment, air filters, and marine HVAC; and after-sales services, including troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, training and technical support, parts and consumables, and error codes. It also provides chemical products, such as fluoropolymers, fluoroelastomers, and fluorine gas; air purification filters and dust collection and sound suppression systems; oil hydraulic pumps and units; defense systems, aircraft parts, and medical equipment; and electronics and IT solutions. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

Organo Corporation engages in water treatment engineering and performance product businesses in Japan, Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers pure water systems, such as reverse osmosis (RO) systems, regenerative automatic and manual pure water systems, electric regeneration pure water systems, desktop and cabinet-type pure water systems, electrodeionization high-purity water systems, cartridge water purifiers, and two-stage RO systems; ultrapure water systems, including desktop and cabinet-type ultrapure water systems, and final polishing units; and other equipment comprising homogenizers, electroconductivity and resistivity meters, and ion exchange filters, as well as marine scrubber wastewater treatment and continuous aerobic granular sludge systems. It also provides water, wastewater, and RO water treatment chemicals; industrial filters consisting of micro filter, sanitary, polypropylene, and plastic housings, as well as micro filters; and commercial water purifiers. In addition, the company offers ultrapure and multi-functional water production systems, wastewater treatment systems, ultra pure ion exchange resin for purifying electronic materials, valuable resource recovery systems, and organic solvent refining systems; purified and UF water production and supply systems, water for injection production and supply systems, and pharmaceutical water system consulting services; water supply and sewage treatment facility products; condensate filters and demineralizers, reactor water and fuel pool cleanup, makeup water, and waste water treatment systems; and sugar refining and decolorization, sugar desalination, amino and acidic sugar refining, and sugar separation equipment. The company was formerly known as Japan Organo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Organo Corporation in 1966. Organo Corporation was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

Toyo Kanetsu K.K. engages in plant and machinery, logistics systems, and other businesses in Japan, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Logistics Solutions Business, Plant Business, and Business Innovation and Incubation segments. The Logistics Solutions segment develops, designs, and manufactures logistics systems centered on sorting, picking, and transportation systems that integrate IT, and performs maintenance systems. The Plant segment is engaged in the maintenance of storage tanks for LNG, LPG, crude oil, and other gases and liquids. Business Innovation and Incubation segment develops and proposes solutions to promote safety and reduce labor in many industries and fields. It is also involved in the building construction business; manufacture and sale of industrial facilities and equipment; real estate rental; leasing operations; and inspection, measurement, analysis of asbestos, etc. The company was formerly known as Toyo Kanetsu Kogyo K.K. and changed its name to Toyo Kanetsu K.K. in 1969. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

Kurita Water Industries Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides water treatment chemicals and equipment in Japan, rest of Asia, North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through Electronics Market and General Water Treatment Market segments. The company offers boiler water, cooling water, and wastewater treatment chemicals; water and wastewater treatment systems; maintenance services; ultrapure water supply; engineering, chemical, and physical cleaning; precision tool cleaning and recycling; operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities; soil and groundwater remediation and survey; and analysis and consigned testing services. It also manufactures and sells water purifiers, softeners, filtration systems, water purifying faucets, faucets, pure water production equipment, and other products and services for commercial and household use. The company serves the electronics, pulp and paper, oil refining and petrochemical, iron and steel, automotive, food and beverage, office and commercial facilities, and power industries. Kurita Water Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Nakano, Japan.

Tsubakimoto Chain Co. manufactures and sells chains, motion control, mobility, materials handling products in Japan. The company offers power transmission products include drive, small size, large size, plastic modular, top, and plastic block chains; sprockets, house and cable carrier systems, timing belts and pulleys, reducers, locking devices, shaft couplings, linear actuators, electrical controllers, mechanical protectors, and clutches. It also provides materials and bulk handling system; conveyance and storage systems, bulk handling systems, metalworking chips handling and coolant processing systems, and high-speed lifters; clutch for drivetrain, timing chain system, Enedrive chain, clutch for e-bike and motorcycle, zip chain actuator, and cableveyor; and eLINK V2X Bi-Directional EV Charging System. Tsubakimoto Chain Co. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

Nikkiso Co., Ltd. engages in industrial, aerospace, and medical businesses worldwide. The company provides pumps and systems, such as canned motor, reciprocating, and cryogenic submerged motor pumps; cryogenic pumps and systems; metering and mixing and odorizing systems; cryogenic heat transfer devices; and cryogenic process plant; precision equipment, including water-conditioning systems for power plants; ceramic substrate production systems; 3D sintering equipment; cold isostatic press; and dryers. It also produces and supplies various parts and components for jet engine, nacelle, and the wings for aircraft using carbon fiber reinforced plastic; and provides hemodialysis equipment. The company was formerly known as Nippon Kikai Keiso Kaisha Ltd. and changed its name to Nikkiso Co., Ltd. in November 1968. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kimura Chemical Plants Co., Ltd. operates as an engineering company. The company offers chemical equipment, including evaporation and concentration plants engineering and concentration, material works, skid mounted units, and solvent recovery systems. It also provides nuclear equipment, such as transport packaging, frogman systems, hot cells, evaporator packages for recovering boric acid, equipment for radioactive treatment, equipment for radiation shielding, electric boilers, globe boxes, fuel handling equipment, irradiation equipment, cleaners for medical treatments, and dust samplers, as well as installations for MOX fuel manufacturing. Kimura Chemical Plants Co., Ltd. was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Oriental Chain Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chain-related and metal injection molding-related products in Japan, rest of Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers standard roller, self-lubricating, extra heavy duty, mini pitch, corrosion and heat resistance, plastic, leaf, hollow pin, double pitch, attachment, top roller, bai speed, conveyor, circular side bow, and cable chains. It also provides OCM MX series standard and agricultural chains, roller chain with outboards, sprockets, pre-threaded attachment chains, PLT chains, ND selube chains, and TLH chains. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Hakusan, Japan.

ANEST IWATA Corporation operates air energy and coating business in Japan, Europe, the United States, China, and internationally. It engages in manufacturing and sales of air compressors, vacuum equipment, coating equipment and systems, and installment equipment. The company offers coating/paint application equipment, which includes spray guns, electrostatic coating machines, and paint supply equipment for industrial and automotive industries; and automatic painting and environmental devices, painting plants and robots, and painting booths. In addition, it provides oil-free scroll vacuum pumps for general industries, semiconductors, food production, research facilities, etc.; and steam power generators. ANEST IWATA Corporation was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Trinity Industrial Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells painting plants, painting equipment, and industrial machinery in Japan. The company engages in the planning, design, manufacture, installation, and after-sales service of painting systems, paint supply equipment, painting equipment, drying equipment, for fields of automobiles, steel parts, aluminum parts, resin parts, housing parts, and aircraft parts fields. It also provides pre-treatment system, electrodeposition coat system, painting booth/air make up system, drying oven/heat treatment furnace, painting system/paint equipment, IoT/digitalization, and environment/carbon neutrality. In addition, the company offers hydraulic transfer line, automatic painting line, hand spray painting line, and molding machines, as well as various evaluation systems and measuring instruments; and water transfer and painting services. Trinity Industrial Corporation was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Toyota, Japan.

Daifuku Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides consulting, engineering, design, manufacture, installation, and after-sales services for material handling systems, car wash machines, and other related equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers storage, transport, sorting, and picking systems to distributors and manufacturers, including e-commerce, retailers, wholesalers, transportation, and warehousing customers, as well as to food, chemicals, and pharmaceuticals manufacturers. It also provides cleanroom transport and storage systems for the manufacturing of semiconductors and flat panel displays; systems for automobile production line systems; airport solutions, including baggage handling systems, automated baggage check-in systems, baggage screening systems, and software and controls; car wash machines and related products to filling stations and automobile dealers; and industrial computers, measuring/control systems, and IoT solutions. The company was formerly known as Daifuku Machinery Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daifuku Co., Ltd. in 1984. Daifuku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. produces and sells vacuum equipment and components for quartz devices, optical thin films, and electronic devices in Japan, China, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Vacuum Technology Application Equipment Business and Service Business segments. The company offers vacuum deposition equipment; arc-discharge-type ion plating equipment; sputtering equipment; atomic layer deposition equipment; etching equipment, such as single wafer and batch type RIE equipment; ashing equipment, including plasma cleaning equipment; wafer trimming equipment; lord lock and in-line type ion beam frequency adjustment equipment; in-line type and high vacuum annealing equipment; film thickness control systems comprising optical film thickness control systems, and wireless temperature and crystal monitors; vacuum equipment for the aerospace industry; vacuum metallurgical equipment for dissolution, heat treatment, sintering, and degassing; multi-color and monochrome optical monitor for thin films; and IAD cold cathode ion source. It also provides SEARCHROID, an image recognition system; EPIoT, an edge computing system for predictive maintenance; hall accelerated ion source/plasma bridge neutralizer; high power RF ion source; ion source for etching; high usage efficiency cathode; and power saving device for oil diffusion pumps. In addition, the company offers modification and repair work. Its products are used in smartphone, automobile, digital camera, endoscope, tablet PC, and light-emitting diode applications. The company serves optical and electronics component industries. The company was formerly known as Showa Shinku Kikai (Showa Vacuum Machinery) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. in 1978. Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

SAMCO Inc. manufactures and sales semiconductor and materials in Japan and internationally. The company primarily offers thin film deposition, microfabrication, cleaning, and surface treatment products. Its deposition systems include atomic layer deposition systems, Plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) systems, liquid source CVD systems, and diamond-like carbon coating systems; and etching systems comprise inductively coupled plasma (ICP), silicon deep reactive ion, reactive ion, and xenon difluoride etching systems. It also provides Aqua Plasma cleaner, a plasma processing equipment; plasma cleaners; and UV ozone cleaners. The company was formerly known as SAMCO International, Inc. and changed its name to SAMCO Inc. in December 2004. SAMCO Inc. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Kato Works Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of mobile cranes, and construction and industrial equipment worldwide. It offers rough terrain, city range, all terrain, truck, and crawler cranes; hydraulic excavators; mini excavators; crawler carriers; earth boring rigs; vacuum trucks; street and snow sweepers; and compact track loaders, as well as spare parts. The company sells its products under the KATO brand. Kato Works Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Kaji Technology Corporation manufactures and sells high-pressure air and gas piston compressors for various applications worldwide. It offers gas, trunk-piston, hydrogen, CNG, and PET compressors; water-cooled/air-cooled type, lubrication/oil-free/oil-less, petrochemical and industrial gas, and PET bottle molding compressors; and SF6 recovery systems, as well as compressors for electric power/test/general industries. The company also provides natural gas vehicle compressors for fuel filling; compressors for fuel cell vehicle filling; and various gas collection and refining equipment. The company was formerly known as Kaji Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kaji Technology Corporation in 1991. Kaji Technology Corporation was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

Yamada Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial and automotive equipment in Japan, the United States, the Netherlands, China, and Thailand. The company's product portfolio includes diaphragm, reciprocating, and sanitary pumps; control and lubrication equipment; grease guns; car service equipment; fluorocarbon exchange/recovery machine; local exhaust ventilations; exhaust systems; high vacuum systems; and hose reels. It also manufactures, imports, and sells medical equipment; installs and maintains equipment related to the item; and designs structures, as well as engages in construction contracting. The company was formerly known as Yamada Yuki Seizo and changed its name to Yamada Corporation in 1990. The company was founded in 1905 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Yuken Kogyo Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells hydraulic equipment and systems, and environmental machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers hydraulic pumps and motors; proportional electro-hydraulic controls; pressure control, flow control, directional control, modular, logic, and linear servo valves; AC servo motor driven pumps, as well as hydraulic cylinders; piston and vane pumps, actuators, and hydrulic power units/power packages; and accessories and others. It also provides various hydraulic systems for industrial machine and marine use; special hydraulic power units; and various power packs. In addition, the company offers PET bottle compacting presses; and automatic chip compactors. Yuken Kogyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Ayase, Japan.

Tadano Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction and vehicle-mounted cranes, aerial work platforms, and transport machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers all-terrain, rough terrain, crawler, truck, and cargo cranes; aerial work platform machines, including hyper and super deck, and skyboy truck and self-propelled; and aerial work platform lineup for electrical work, communication and general construction, heavy load construction, and shipbuilding. It also provides vehicle transport, industrial vehicle transport, elevated road/bridge inspection, Pole digger, Orbital land vehicle, illuminated vehicle, marine crane, all-terrain crane detachable lifter, lifter, and lift house. The company was formerly known as Tadano Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tadano Ltd. in 1989. Tadano Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

Unozawa-gumi Iron Works, Limited manufactures and sells pump and blower in Japan. The company operates through Manufacturing business and Real Estate Business segments. It offers dry vacuum pumps, rotary blowers and vacuum pumps, and water ring vacuum pumps. The company also provides periodic maintenance, repair and renewal, and diagnosis and inspection services. It also operates the property rental business. Unozawa-gumi Iron Works was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Fuji Seiki Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells precision molds, molding systems, and precision molded components in Japan, China, Indonesia, Thailand, and internationally. The company offers precision molding components for medical devices, automotive parts, and plastic containers; disc cases; and medical devices. It also offers injection molded components. Fuji Seiki Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kanematsu Engineering Co., Ltd. offers trucks and machines in Japan and internationally. The company provides high-power suction trucks, including mobile vac, heat exchangers, stationary suction machines, powder cleaners, lift up mobile, and gutter cleaners; and high-pressure cleaning trucks, such as mobile jets. It also engages in sales of powder and granular material suction and pumping vehicles. It offers its products for industrial waste disposal, iron and steel, electric power, shipbuilding, and other companies. Kanematsu Engineering Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Kochi, Japan.

Suzumo Machinery Company Limited manufactures and sells food machines for small kitchens and factories worldwide. The company provides sushi machine; rice serving machine; roll sushi machine; onigiri making machine; rice cooker and mixer; rice weighting and serving machine; sushi wrapping machine; and sushi making machine. It also offers rice cooking net, rice pack, Shari tray, lubricant oil/anti-sticking oil, easy-open sushi wrapping film, anti-fog wrap, and polyethylene disposable gloves, rice container cart. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

CKD Corporation develops, manufactures, sells, and exports automation machinery and components in Japan and Internationally. The company offers components products, such as electric actuators, direct drive actuators, pneumatic cylinders, hand and chucks, assistive devices, software, directional control valves, refining and pressure adjusting components, speed control valves check valves, auxiliary equipment, gas generators, fluid control components, sensors, controllers, vacuum system components, and mechanical indexer, as well as components for chemical liquids, high vacuum and special gas, and controllers for primary industries and irrigation. It also provides automatic machinery, including automatic packaging systems and lithium-ion battery winding machine. The company was formerly known as Chukyo Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CKD Corporation in July 1979. CKD Corporation was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Komaki, Japan.

Ogura Clutch Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells clutches and brakes for the general industry in Japan and internationally. It offers clutch brakes, such as for office equipment, machine tools, construction and industrial machinery, etc; fiber tensioner, automotive A/C clutches, root blowers (superchargers), power clutches, oil mist separators, high-pressure coolant systems, disaster prevention systems, etc. The company also provides solenoids for powertrains, as well as PTO clutches for riding, zero-turn, and commercial walk-behind mowers. Its products are used in office equipment, machine tools, construction machinery, industrial machinery, and car air conditioners. The company was formerly known as Ogura Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ogura Clutch Co.,Ltd. in May 1961. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Kiryu, Japan.

Sankyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells game machines and ball bearing supply systems in Japan. It operates through the Pachinko Machines Business, Pachislot Machines Business, Supply Equipment Related Business, and Other Businesses segments. The Pachinko Machines Business segment produces and sells pachinko machines, machine gauges, and related parts. The Pachinko Machines Business segment produces and sells pachislot machines and sells related parts. The Supply Equipment Related Business segment produces and sells pachinko and pachislot replenishment device, card system equipment, and hall equipment peripherals. The Other Businesses segment engages in real estate rental and sale of general molded parts. It also offers planning and production of effect control software and video content for pachinko and pachislot machine development services. The company also offers mobile content services; card system equipment, and peripheral equipment for hall facilities; and operates a golf club. It sells its products under the SANKYO, Bisty, and JB brands. Sankyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Japan Cash Machine Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells of currency handling machines and equipment for amusement facilities in Japan and internationally. It operates through Global Gaming, Overseas Commercials, Domestic Commercials, and recreation hall equipment segments. It offers banknote recycler, banknote recycler with four denomination recycling, coin recycler, coin recycler with double sided insertion slot, modular banknote recycler, bill validator, recycler unit, bill validator with banknote storage box, plasma cluster Ion generating unit systems for spacious areas, cash/ cashless multi payment machine flexcom pay, and access control systems. It serves retail, transportation, casinos/gaming, environment, clinic, and system products markets. Japan Cash Machine Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Mars Group Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, sale, and provision of services for peripheral devices for amusement-related facilities in Japan. It operates through the Amusement Related Business, Smart Solution Related Business, and Hotel and Restaurant Related Business segments. The company plans, develops, manufactures, and sells automatic identification systems, such as RFID, bar code, two-dimensional code, and X-ray inspection systems; designs, manufactures, and sells electronic and information equipment, banknote recognition machines, card readers, vending machines, and card printers; plans and sells information processing equipment; content distribution business; and provides information processing services. It is also involved in the creation, operation, sale, and management of membership management, and provision of related information services; manufacturing and sales of press work, molds, and machinery; third-party management of card systems; software development business; design and contracting, construction, and supervision of construction works; management of hotels and restaurants; leasing business and property rental management; and planning, production, and sale of printed materials for advertising and promotion. In addition, the company engages in the sales and after-sales services of amusement-related equipment. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Galilei Holdings Co.Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sale of commercial refrigerators and freezers, frozen showcases, and other equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers ice makers, blast chillers and shock freezers; dough conditioning equipment; commercial dishwashers; medical cool boxes, low temperature incubators, and ultra-low-temperature freezers; CO2 refrigeration systems; and tunnel and spiral freezers. The company also provides inspect, repair, and maintenance services. It serves its products to in food service industry, supermarkets, drugstores, convenience stores, and medical and life science research. The company exports in 11 countries in China and Southeast Asia. The company was formerly known as Galilei Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Galilei Holdings Co.Ltd. in July 2026. Galilei Holdings Co.Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Takamisawa Cybernetics Company, Ltd. manufactures and sells transportation system, mechatronics, and special system equipment in Japan. The company offers transportation equipment, such as ticket vending machine, automatic commutation ticket issuing machine, automatic fare adjustment machine, IC card charge machine, ticket issuing machine, platform door/lifting type platform fence, and hosting system; mechatronics equipment, including banknote handling, coin handling, card handling, and issuing banknotes handling machines, as well as original equipment manufacturing product development. It also provides gate machines, access management system, card vending machine, parking place management system, custom-made power source open door temperature control chamber, and disaster prevention measurement system. In addition, the company is involved in the Installation and maintenance of various vending and bicycle parking facilities.
Takamisawa Cybernetics Company, Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Nakano, Japan.

Universal Entertainment Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and sells pachislot and pachinko machines in Japan and the Philippines. It develops and provides Falcon X, a peripheral system; Hot Stadium, a digital signage system; Universal Kingdom, a members-only mobile website; Slot Street, a social casino game for smartphones; Fun, amusement equipment; and Pachislot and Pachinko machines and related equipment, as well as operates OKADA MANILA, a casino resort in the Philippines. It also offers Okada Maa, the integrated resort facilities in Manila, the Philippines. The company was formerly known as Aruze Corp. and changed its name to Universal Entertainment Corporation in November 2009. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Universal Entertainment Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Okada Holdings Limited.

OIZUMI Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of automatic service equipment, system equipment, and gaming machines for entertainment industry in Japan. The company offers medal polishing, currency exchange machine, supplying and recovery systems, medal and medal lending machine, and bill transport systems, as well as pachislot and panchiko machines, and gaming machine mechanism units; ball supply and recovery systems; game center POS; and ball storage systems. It also provides maintenance, information processing, and real estate rental and management services; spare parts; game software; and package games, video/music, publishing, and online amusement. In addition, the company is involved in licensing of ball supplying machine related patents; development of amusement park information systems; and internet content distribution. Further, it operates solar power generation and other, as well as food and e-commerce businesses; generates and sells electricity; manufactures, processes, and sells agricultural products, such as jelly and jellies; and develops health foods and cosmetics. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Atsugi, Japan.

Daikoku Denki Co., Ltd. development, production, and sale of computer systems pachinko parlors in Japan. The company operates through Information system business and Amusement business segments. It also develops, manufactures, and sells units for pachinko and pachislot gaming machines. In addition, the company provides Daikoku Denki Strategic Information System, a service system to help pachinko hall operators formulate management strategies; and information on pachinko halls and game machines through PC and cell-phone Web sites, and pay TV channels. Daikoku Denki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Takeuchi Mfg. Co., Ltd. engages in development, manufacture, and sales of construction machinery in Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and China. The company offers mini and hydraulic excavators, crawler loader, crawler carrier, and deep foundation drilling machine. Takeuchi Mfg. Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Hanishina, Japan.

HEPHAIST Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells linear motion devices and precision parts in Japan, China, and internationally. The company offers high-precision positioning stage, including XY ?, ultra-precision, Z-tilt, and Z-axis stages; linear bearing products, such as linear ball blushing, shaft holder, and miniature ball screw spline; ball spline with integrated rotary bearing; and spherical bearing, short shaft type, and sliding spherical bearing. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Hephaist Seiko Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to HEPHAIST Co., Ltd. in June 2020. HEPHAIST Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Kawagoe, Japan.

Amano Corporation provides time information, parking, environmental, and cleaning systems in Japan and internationally. The company offers time information systems, including time and attendance (T&A), payroll information, human resources and information, and access information systems; employee administration, cloud, and photo ID card issuing services; time recorders; and digital time stamps. It also provides parking systems, such as gate- and flap-locking type parking, bicycle parking, security gate, and toll road systems; and ticketless LPR, parking facility data center, and commissioned management services. In addition, the company offers environmental systems, including dust collectors, mist collectors, vacuum cleaners, commercial air purifiers, large-scale dust collectors, pneumatic conveying systems, measurements for powder physicality, and visualization systems for microparticles. Further, it provides cleaning and robot solutions, such as autonomous robotic floor and compact automatic floor scrubbers, compact carpet cleaners, industrial vacuum cleaners, floor polishers, electronic high-speed burnishers, hand-pushed sweepers, and electrolytic water generators. Amano Corporation was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Juki Corporation manufactures and sells industrial and household sewing machines, and industrial equipment in Japan, China, India, rest of Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Sewing Business; and Industrial Equipment Business segments. It offers industrial sewing machines for sewing apparel products, underwear, sportswear, shoes, bags, indoor furniture, daily commodities, car interior components, and hobby and amusement items; household sewing machines, professional sewing machines, and compact overlock sewing machines; and surface mounting technology (SMT) related equipment that are used primarily to mount electronic components, such as IC chips, semiconductors, and capacitors on electronic circuit boards. The company is also involved in the contract development and manufacturing business; and provides automated warehouse solutions. In addition, it provides smart solutions for sewing factories and circuit boards manufacturing factories. Juki Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Tama, Japan.

Sanden Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of automotive air conditioning systems and compressors in Japan, Europe, and internationally. It offers heat pump system products; system product components, such as compressors, HVAC units, heat exchangers, electric coolant heaters, and pipes for air conditioning. The company is also involved in provision of air conditioning systems for off highway vehicles; and intercoolers. The company was formerly known as Sanden Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Sanden Corporation in January 2022. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Isesaki, Japan. Sanden Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Hisense Japan Automotive Air-Conditioning Systems Corporation.

JANOME Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sewing machines in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Household Appliances, Industrial Equipment, IT-Related, and Others. The company offers sewing and embroidery machines, overlocker, and CoverPro; and desktop robots, servo presses, and die-cast products. It also engages in IT software and information processing services; and real estate rental. The company was formerly known as Janome Sewing Machine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JANOME Corporation in October 2021. JANOME Corporation was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Hachioji, Japan.

Brother Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells communications and printing equipment in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates through segments: Printing and Solutions Business, Industrial Printing Business, Machinery Business, Nissei Business, Personal and Home Business, and Other Businesses. The Printing and Solutions Business offers printers, all-in-ones, labeling systems, label printers, and scanners. The Industrial Printing Business provides coding and marking equipment, digital printing equipment, and garment printers. The Machinery Business offers machine tools and industrial sewing machines. The Nissei Business provides gearmotors, high stiffness reducers, and gears. The Personal and Home Business offers home sewing and cutting machines. It is involved in manufacture and sells printers, multifunction devices, label writers, label printers, and scanners; industrial printing equipment; machine tools and industrial sewing machines; speed reducers and gears, and real estate leasing; and household sewing machines; as well as leases real estate. The company was formerly known as Nippon Sewing Machine Manufacturing Co. and changed its name to Brother Industries, Ltd. in 1962. Brother Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Max Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial, office, and HCR equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers pneumatic nailers, hand tackers, screw driving machines, staples, nails, screws, air compressors, laser markers, rebar tying tools, battery-operated wire mesh cutter, pin insertion machines for concrete, gas nailers, hammer drills, battery-operated impact drivers, battery-operated pin nailers, vegetable binders, tape binding tools, bag closing machines, battery-operated pruning scissors, heater-ventilator-dryers for bathrooms, 24-hour ventilation systems, floor heating systems, disposer systems, and residential fire alarms. It also provides staplers, staples, paper-made staple staplers, electronic staplers, electric staple removers, auto staplers, automatic binding machines, numbering machines, punches, stamp pads, red ink pads, time recorders, timecards, checkwriters, sign-making machines, label printers, tube markers, signboard creation software, signboard creation machines, and parallel rulers. In addition, the company offers HCR equipment, such as wheelchairs and other welfare equipment. The company was formerly known as Max Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Max Co., Ltd. in 1964. Max Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Morita Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of ladder trucks, fire trucks, and specialty vehicles in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Fire truck, disaster prevention, Industrial machinery, and Eco-friendly vehicles. It offers fire trucks, including ladder trucks, aerial platforms, chemical/water tenders, rescue truck, aircraft rescue and fire fighting vehicles, multi-purpose fire fighting vehicles, CAFS/water pumps, and maintenance. It also provides recycling machines comprising shredder plants, scrap shears, and scrap baling presses. In addition, the company offers environmental conservation vehicles, such as cesspit emptiers, garbage collectors, container lifters, cleaning vehicles, vacuum tanks, lumbar support wear, and home-visit bathing service cars. Further, it provides fire extinguishers, fire protection-related equipment; hydraulic equipment; designs and constructs waste recycling facilities and other waste disposal facilities; electronic applied machinery and information processing machinery; FRP cabins and bodies for fire trucks; sells portable pumps, fire alarm detectors, and fire trucks and equipment; platform ladders and aerial platforms; and maintenance and aftercare services, as well as engages in the trading, fabrication, repair, and sale of specialized vehicles. The company was formerly known as Morita Corporation and changed its name to Morita Holdings Corporation in October 2008. Morita Holdings Corporation was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Glory Ltd. develops, manufactures and sells cash handling machines in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. It operates through Financial Market, Retail and Transportation Market, Amusement Market, and Overseas Market segments. The company offers self-service coin and banknote recyclers for cashiers and offices, teller cash recyclers, assisted service solution, teller concierge, compact banknote counter/sorter, banknote sorting machine, coin sorter, and coin wrapper; and open teller systems, multi-functional banknote change dispenser, valuable item management, electronic booking board, PC integrated scanner. It also provides change dispenser, hybrid deposit machines, consolidated electronic money readers, smart locker, small deposit/withdraw machines, sales proceeds deposit machines, touch panel ticket vending machines, automatic registers, medical payment machines, and ballot sorters. In addition, the company offers machine-attached counting units and prize storage machines; and facial recognition system and collaborative robot. It serves financial, retail, transportation, amusement and gaming, and other markets. The company was formerly known as Kokuei Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Glory Ltd. in 1971. The company was founded in 1918 and is based in Himeji, Japan.

Sinko Industries Ltd. manufactures, sells, and installs air conditioning equipment in Japan and internationally. The company provides air conditioners, air handling unit, air handling terminal type, air handling compact type; heat pump air handling unit; data center air handling unit; heat exchanger; fan coil unit; and unit heater. It also offers large air volume fan coil unit; and special model fan coil unit. In addition, the company's products are used in central air conditioning systems, offices, factories, hospitals, and hotels. Sinko Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Daiwa Ltd. manufactures, sells, and leases freezers, refrigerators, showcases, ice makers, cooling systems, and vending machines in Japan and internationally. It also engages in the installation of cooling equipment, and manufacture and sale of its parts; manufacturing, selling, and leasing of kitchen equipment, devices, and parts; planning, designing, and construction of stores and kitchens; other construction works; and power generation and selling electricity. In addition, the company also offers undercounters; and health and science equipment. The company was formerly known as Daiwa Industries Ltd. and changed its name to Daiwa Ltd. in July 2026. Daiwa Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Sega Sammy Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the entertainment contents business in Japan, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Entertainment Contents Business, Pachislot and Pachinko Machines Business, and Gaming Business segments. The Entertainment Contents Business segment engages in the development and sale of consumer game software, such as Full Game and F2P, etc., as well as amusement machines; planning, production, and sale of animated films; and development, manufacture, and sale of toys. Its Pachislot and Pachinko Machines Business segment is involved in the development, manufacture, sale of pachislot and pachinko machines. The Gaming Business segment engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of gaming devices and casino machines; online gaming business; and development and operation of the Paradise City integrated resort. Sega Sammy Holdings Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

TPR Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sale of engine components in Japan, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers powertrain parts, such as piston rings, cylinder liners, carbon scraper rings, valve seat, valve guide, sintered/steel seal ring, and shock absorber parts. It also provides industrial rubber parts, resin seal rings, home equipment, temperature control valves, infrared heater/related equipment, aluminum products; EV related products, such as driver and battery related products, as well as surface treatment products. In addition, the company offers carbon nano tube and nano porous material; exterior resin parts comprising radiator grille and millimeter wave radar covers; metal/molding parts, such as window molding/SUS molding and roof rails; electrical and electronic parts, including radiator grilles with illumination and telematics communication units; shock absorber parts; automotive related equipment; home equipment, life support/service related services; and CoRoMoCo, a communication support robot for use in nursing care facilities, that can measure heart rate and feelings when held. The company was formerly known as Teikoku Piston Ring Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TPR Co., Ltd. in October 2011. TPR Co., Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tsubaki Nakashima Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial precision balls, rollers, blowers, and medical equipment and hygiene equipment in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Precision Components Business and Bloor Real Estate Business segments. It offers precision steel balls, including bearing and stainless steel, ballpoint pen, and various metal balls for use in home electronics, such as air conditioners, refrigerators, and vacuum cleaners; and precision tapered, spherical, cylindrical, and needle rollers. The company also provides precision ceramic balls, including silicon nitride and alumina oxide balls for use in wind power generators, electric vehicles, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment applications. In addition, it offers medical and metrology products. Further, the company provides iron and steel, electric power, wind tunnel, and other blowers for steel, thermal power, nuclear power, biomass power, and other applications; and customized solutions comprising solid plastic balls, specially manufactured products, and glass balls for medical diagnostic tests and devices. Additionally, it is involved in real estate leasing. Tsubaki Nakashima Co., Ltd. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Hoshizaki Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and sells commercial kitchen appliances and equipment in Japan, the United States, Europe, the rest of Asia. It offers ice making, commercial refrigeration and freezing, thawing, cleaning, hygiene management, cooking, bread making, drink service, food service, and freshness management equipment, as well as prefabricated warehouse; and other services, such as equipment and temperature control systems to the food service, retail, hospitality, food and beverages processing, healthcare, and agriculture and fishery industries. The company was formerly known as Hoshizaki Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hoshizaki Corporation in July 2016. Hoshizaki Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Toyoake, Japan.

TVE Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, and maintenance of industrial valves, electrical equipment, reconstruction, and other decommissioning equipment in Japan. It operates through Electrical Equipment, Steel Manufacturing, and Valve Business segments. The company offers valves for nuclear power plant, thermal plant, ships, petrochemical plants, and other power plants, as well as manufacture and sell cast steel products. It also constructs electrical equipment for nuclear power plants; gate valves, such as wedge gate and parallel slide valves; safety/relief valves, including open safety, sealed relief, electromagnetic relief, general purpose safety, pressurizer, vacuum, main steam safety, moisture separation heater relief, cross-around pipe safety valves; and globe valve, Y-valve, and angle valve. In addition, the company provides swing check, lift check, tilting check, stop check, and bleed check valves; and special valves comprising through conduit, pressure stop, needle, fuel transfer pipe gate, main steam isolation, main steam check, and safety injection system valves, as well as flow meters. Further, it offers maintenance services; and produces and supplies stainless, heat-resistant, and other steel products. The company offers its products for nuclear power generation; thermal, IPP, and in-house power generation; oil, petrochemicals, and LNG; and marine vessels. TVE Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Toa Valve Engineering Inc. and changed its name to TVE Co., Ltd. in September 2020. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Nichidai Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells precision-forged dies and related forged products in Japan, Thailand, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Molds, Precision Parts, and Filters. The company offers precision forging dies that are used in the production of automotive parts; forged parts and assembly of precision parts; and sintered wire mesh filters which are used in the petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and food industries; chemical and nuclear plants; and the H-IIA rocket. In addition, its products include precision forging dies, such as press and former dies; formed products comprising cross joints, inner races, bevel gears, and scrolls; and die sets, including hydraulic enclosing mechanism with pantograph system, hydraulic back pressure, and gas pressure enclosed die sets. Further, the company provides forging DX; precision forgings; and filters, as well as contracted development services. Nichidai Corporation was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

long_name: Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd.
business_summary: Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electric discharge machining, industrial gas turbine parts, and other metal products. The company operates through Electric discharge machining and surface treatment, Molds, Machinery, equipment, and Others. It also offers aircraft engine parts, servo press machines, fully chrome-free coating, dies and molding, and automotive parts. In addition, the company provides dies-molding, and extrusion dies for aluminum and ceramic honeycomb. Further it engages in surface treatment of aircraft engine components, gas turbine components, and automobile-related items, chromium-free coating; and creating mechatronics products, making, and manufacturing of related items, and commissioning of press composite processing system, digital servo press, and press parts. Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Taiho Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells bearings in Japan. It offers engine parts, such as vacuum pumps, exhaust valves, turbocharger parts, engine parts top, and engine bearings; drive auxiliary bearing and compressor parts; and noise damping PCU covers, stack manifold and pressure plates, and adhesive gaskets, as well as fuel cell power generation contract testing products. The company also offers aluminum die-cast products and precision molds. Taiho Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Toyota, Japan.

NSK Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial machinery bearings, automotive products, and precision equipment and parts worldwide. The company's products include ball bearings; roller bearings; bearing units; super precision bearings; bearings for steel industry, mining and construction, papermaking machines, and pumps and compressors; and bearings for special environments, including sanitary, corrosion-resistant, vacuum, cleanroom, high-temperature, non-magnetic requirement, and dust-contaminated environments. It also provides automotive products, which comprise chassis products, such as electric power steerings, steering column and intermediate shafts, brake systems, and hub unit bearings; electrification Products; and power train products comprising engine parts and electrical accessories, automatic and manual transmission, differential gear and propeller shafts, electrical accessories, engine parts, toroidal CVT POWERTOROS unit, and motorcycles and all-terrain vehicles. In addition, the company offers precision machine components, including ball screws, linear guides, monocarriers linear actuators, XY tables, and spindles; and accessories, including ball screw support bearings, air bearings, and clean grease, as well as support units for heavy and light loads, machine tools, and small equipment. Further, the company provides megatorque motors and maintenance services; and digital services comprising condition monitoring solutions through wireless vibration diagnostic device D-VibA10. It serves agriculture, automotive, cement, food and beverage, industrial motor and gearbox, injection molding machine, machine tool, medical device, mining and construction, motorcycle, office equipment, palm oil, papermaking machinery, pump and compressor, railway, semiconductor, steel and metal, sugar, and wind turbine industries. NSK Ltd. was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

NTN Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells bearings, products, and CVJ axle products in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers rolling bearings, including radial and thrust ball, radial and thrust roller, special purpose, and linear motion bearings; plummer blocks; bearing units; sliding bearings; constant velocity joints; auto tensioners; clutches; electric motors and actuators; sensor related products; parts feeders; condition monitoring systems; sintered machine parts; and power generators. It also provides aftermarket parts and maintenance services. The company serves automobile and motorcycle, electric vehicle, railway vehicle, wind turbines, construction and mining machinery, agricultural machinery, office equipment, iron manufacturing machinery, food machinery, machine tools, paper manufacturing machinery, food machinery, aerospace, medical equipment, precision equipment, robots, electrical machinery, vacuum and clean, gear reducer, and green energy products markets. NTN Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

JTEKT Corporation manufactures and sells steering systems, driveline components, bearings, machine tools, electronic control devices, and home accessory equipment in Japan, the United States, the rest of North America, Europe, the rest of Asia, Oceania, China, and internationally. It operates through Automotive, Industrial and Bearings, and Machine Tools segments. The company offers steering systems and drivelines for the automotive industry; bearings for industrial machinery; and control machines and industrial heat furnaces. It also provides transmission components; machine tools, such as grinders, machining centers, gear skiving/gear cutting machines, and cutting machines; programmable logic controllers, including motion controllers; IoE solutions; industrial heat treatment equipment, heat treatment equipment for semiconductor manufacturing and advanced technology devices, heat treatment equipment for electronic component manufacturing and research and development, compressors, assembly and inspection machines, inspection testers, electronic test instruments and equipment, maintenance equipment, and metal-bonded wheel forming machines. In addition, the company offers tools comprising dressers, vitrified CBN and diamond wheels, metal and resin wheels, PCD and PCBN products, and electroplated wheels; displays consisting of IoE, monitors/general purpose operation panels, electronic counters, digital tachometers and timers, programmable displays, HMI software, and panel computers; bevel, cylindrical, and worm gears; component parts, such as oil seals, shafts, and precision mechanical equipment; sensor products, including IoE, water level meters, rotary encoders, and proximity sensors; and storage devices comprising lithium-ion capacitors. The company was formerly known as Koyo Seiko Co. Ltd. JTEKT Corporation was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Kariya, Japan.

Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. manufactures and sells machine tools, parts, and other products in Japan, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company provides cutting tools, including drills, taps, end mills, and precision tools; machine tools, such as skiving machining center for gears, broaching machines, precision roll forming machines, grinding machines, power finishers, and machining cells; and robots that include handling, palletizing, spot welding, heavy duty, cleanroom, and controllers. It also offers bearings, which include stop fake bearings, radial ball bearings, radial roller bearings, thrust ball bearings, thrust roller bearings, bearing units, plummer block housing, and bearings for specific application; hydraulic equipment, including valve, pump, motor, unit, rotary center joint, construction machines, machine tools, press and molding, and automobile; and automotive hydraulics, such as solenoid valve for automobile. Additionally, the company provides high grade special steels and thermotech, including industrial furnaces, degreasing machine, coating equipment, and coating services. Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MINEBEA MITSUMI Inc. manufactures and supplies machinery components, electronic devices and components, automotive, and industrial machinery and home security business in Japan and internationally. It operates through Precision Technologies; Motor, Lighting & Sensing; Semiconductors & Electronics; Access Solutions, and other segments. The company offers bearing products, including miniature and small-sized ball bearings, rod end and spherical bearings, roller bearings, bushings, precision machined parts for aircraft, and medium- and large-sized ball bearings for aerospace use. It also provides bearing-related products, such as pivot assemblies and precision mechanical assemblies; and fasteners, ball screws/ball ways, and magnetic clutches and brakes.
